jobs.title: Director, Technical Recruiting
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Director of Technical Recruiting to lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of technical hiring across the company. In this role, you will lead and develop a high-performing technical recruiting team that partners closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Hardware, and our leadership team to attract exceptional talent and accelerate innovation. You are both a strategic talent leader and an operational builder - equally comfortable shaping long-term workforce strategies, coaching recruiters, and diving into complex searches yourself when needed.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and develop a world-class technical recruiting organization, fostering a high-performance, quality-driven, candidate-centric culture.

  • Partner with executive leadership, hiring managers, People Operations, and Finance to develop hiring strategies aligned with the business priorities of WHOOP and long-term growth plans.

  • Own technical recruiting performance, including capacity planning, role assignment, funnel health, quality of hire, time-to-fill, offer acceptance, and candidate experience metrics, using data to continuously improve outcomes.

  • Build scalable recruiting processes, interview frameworks, and talent programs that enable consistent, high-quality hiring across Engineering, Product, Data Science, AI/ML, Hardware, and other technical functions.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to technical leaders, providing market intelligence, compensation insights, interview process guidance, and recommendations on hiring strategy.

  • Champion proactive talent engagement through employer branding, talent mapping, networking, and pipeline development for critical and emerging technical skill sets.

  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure recruiting practices support a high-performing hiring process while maintaining an extremely high hiring bar.

  • In tandem with Talent Operations, continuously evaluate and support implementing recruiting technologies, AI-enabled sourcing tools, and operational improvements that increase recruiter productivity and hiring effectiveness.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience with significant leadership experience managing technical recruiting teams in high-growth technology organizations.

  • Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading recruiting organizations that consistently deliver exceptional technical talent.

  • Deep understanding of recruiting for a wide variety of technical disciplines that include software engineering, machine learning, data science, hardware, embedded systems, product, manufacturing, and other highly technical disciplines.

  • Experience partnering with executive leadership on workforce planning, organizational scaling, and executive-level hiring.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience leveraging recruiting metrics, market data, and forecasting to drive strategic decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and balance competing business priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

  • Experience implementing and optimizing recruiting technologies, applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms, and AI-enabled recruiting workflows.

  • Excellent leadership, coaching, communication, and relationship-building skills with a passion for developing high-performing teams.

  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating with a "no task too small" mindset, recognizing that building a great organization requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Manager (Operations)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. As we scale our physical product business and global footprint, data-driven operations are critical to delivering a seamless, high-quality member experience. WHOOP is hiring a Business Analytics Manager to partner with our Operations teams to create visibility, drive accountability, and unlock insights that enable better service, lower cost, and faster decision-making.

This role is ideal for someone fluent in data and obsessed with uncovering operational inefficiencies that impact financial performance and the member experience. You will be empowered to shape our data infrastructure, define performance metrics, and drive change across a global ecosystem of vendors and partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Generate and drive the strategic analytic roadmap to identify exceptions and inefficiencies across the order lifecycle — shipping delays, cost drivers, inventory inaccuracies, and service-level gaps — and translate them into actionable insights.

  • Own operational metrics, ensuring clarity, alignment, and regular review across stakeholders; bridge operations and finance on forecasting, spend tracking, and variance analysis to ensure operational data and financial reporting tell the same story.

  • Lead analytics for quarterly cost reduction initiatives, including fulfillment COGS, freight costs, and cost per contact. Partner with Finance on total cost reporting and gross margin analysis.

  • Contribute to S&OP reviews and Operations OKR check-ins. Deliver the data that shapes prioritization and resource allocation across the operations organization.

  • Partner with Operations, Membership Services, and Finance to improve accuracy, vendor accountability, and overall member experience.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to improve pipeline reliability and data access across key operational systems.

  • Build, maintain, and ensure accurate, reliable data assets and trusted metric definitions within our semantic layer — from data pipelines to dashboards and regular performance reviews.

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of analysts, fostering a culture of high performance and continuous improvement. Ensure each analyst has clear workstream ownership and the context they need to proactively identify problems.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of experience in analytics, operations, supply chain, fulfillment, or logistics in a consumer business (eCommerce, hardware, CPG, or retail preferred).

  • Experience managing or mentoring analysts. You should enjoy coaching and have a perspective on how to grow early-career analysts into workstream owners.

  • Strong business judgment and ability to connect operational data to cost, experience, and strategic priorities.

  • Proven ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels and context-switch between them without dropping quality.

  • Comfort representing analytics in cross-functional settings and demonstrated success in influencing senior stakeholders on strategic direction based on data-driven insights.

  • Proficiency in SQL; experience with dbt, Snowflake, or similar ELT/data warehouse platforms.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $180,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training. 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (AI Quality)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers users to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our wearable device tracks key physiological metrics such as heart rate variability, resting heart rate, and sleep quality to provide personalized insights into fitness, health, and recovery.

The AI Quality team at WHOOP is responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and integrity of the AI models that power these insights, delivering cutting-edge AI technologies that our members can trust.

As an Engineering Manager at WHOOP, you will have both technical and people management responsibilities. On the technical side, you will partner with product and engineering leaders to uphold our "Measure What Matters" principle, ensuring every AI initiative has clear, visible, and actionable metrics. You will guide a team of AI and ML engineers in developing robust technical designs, architecture, and operational excellence. You will embody our "Decisions Over Consensus" principle, providing clear technical direction and documenting the rationale for high-stakes AI architecture choices.

On the people management side, you will foster a culture of innovation, teamwork, psychological safety, and continuous learning, ensuring all team members feel empowered to do their best work.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and manage a team of cross-skilled engineers responsible for measuring and improving the quality of AI outputs.

  • Champion the "Measure What Matters" principle by establishing rigorous testing frameworks to evaluate model drift and performance.

  • Exercise "Decisions Over Consensus" to provide clear technical direction and resolve alignment stalls for the team.

  • Manage third-party vendor relationships, overseeing both technology integration and partnership performance.

  • Define technical strategy, architecture, and design for AI quality.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize engineering productivity and quality.

  • Provide mentorship and coaching to team members to support their professional growth.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant experience building and measuring the quality of AI/ML products.

  • Proven experience managing third-party vendor relationships and technology partnerships.

  • Strong technical skills in Applied AI, Machine Learning, and software deployment lifecycles.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and people management skills.

  • Passion for wearable technology and experience thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Experience managing an AI product at scale is a plus.

jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. Our wearable technology provides personalized insights that help millions of members better understand their bodies, and make smarter decisions about training, recovery, and lifestyle.

WHOOP is seeking a Security Architect to help build and scale the Security Architecture function within the Information Security organization. This role will play a foundational part in defining how security architecture is practiced across the company by establishing standards, governance, reusable design patterns, and trusted partnerships with engineering teams.

The successful candidate will bring broad technical expertise across application, infrastructure, cloud, and enterprise security while building strong relationships throughout the organization. They will help create practical security standards, influence technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and enable the business to move quickly without compromising security. This role requires someone who enjoys working with people as much as solving technical problems and can translate complex security concepts into clear, actionable guidance. Working closely with the Security Architecture Lead and the broader CISO organization, this individual will help shape the long-term vision and operating model for Security Architecture at WHOOP.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, IT, and Security teams to provide architectural guidance throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security is incorporated early into design decisions.

  • Help establish and mature WHOOP's Security Architecture practice by defining architecture governance, review methodologies, security standards, and engagement models that scale with the organization.

  • Develop and maintain security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns that enable engineering teams to build secure systems consistently.

  • Review application, cloud, infrastructure, AI, and enterprise technology initiatives to identify architectural risks, validate security controls, and recommend practical mitigation strategies.

  • Lead architecture reviews and collaborate with engineering teams on threat models, trust boundaries, data flows, identity patterns, secure service-to-service communications, and security design decisions.

  • Provide technical leadership across application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, API security, identity and access management, secrets management, network security, and data protection.

  • Work closely with Product Security, Infrastructure Security, and Engineering teams to establish consistent security expectations across new products, internal platforms, and third-party integrations.

  • Evaluate the security architecture of strategic vendors and technology solutions as part of WHOOP's Third-Party Risk Assessment process.

  • Translate regulatory and compliance requirements—including HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST frameworks—into practical engineering guidance and architectural controls.

  • Mentor engineers and security team members on secure design principles, helping raise the organization's overall security maturity through collaboration, education, and trusted technical leadership.

  • Produce clear architectural documentation, technical standards, design reviews, and implementation guidance that can be consistently applied across engineering teams.

  • Partner with Security leadership to define the long-term vision, operating model, roadmap, and success metrics for Security Architecture as a strategic capability within the Information Security organization.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering and business leaders, balancing security, operational efficiency, and business objectives while promoting a secure-by-design culture across WHOOP.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8–12+ years of experience in security architecture, application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, or senior security engineering roles supporting modern distributed systems.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and securing cloud-native applications and infrastructure, with deep knowledge of AWS security services and modern cloud architecture.

  • Strong understanding of application security, secure software development, infrastructure security, cloud security, API security, identity and access management, enterprise networking, and modern security architecture principles.

  • Previous software engineering or application development experience with the ability to understand application design, architecture, implementation tradeoffs, and engineering workflows.

  • Experience performing architecture reviews, security design assessments, and threat modeling for complex distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with healthcare, regulated environments, or security programs supporting HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53, or similar regulatory and compliance frameworks.

  • Ability to balance security requirements with business objectives and provide practical, risk-based recommendations that engineering teams can successfully implement.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to build trust, influence technical decisions, and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, IT, and security organizations.

  • A collaborative, approachable, and service-oriented mindset with the ability to establish strong working relationships across teams and become a trusted partner to engineers and technical leaders.

  • Comfortable working independently while helping establish new security processes, standards, governance models, and architectural practices in a growing organization.

  • High integrity, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to solving complex security challenges.

  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, GIAC, TOGAF, or equivalent are considered a plus.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $155,000 - $195,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through meaningful insights into their bodies and daily lives, transforming the way they approach health and performance.

WHOOP is seeking a highly skilled Senior Systems Engineer to join our Systems Engineering team within the hardware organization. This position bridges multiple disciplines—Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Signal Processing, and Product—to ensure system-level excellence in our wearable technology. As a technical leader in the hardware team, you will guide system architecture, influence product direction, and collaborate across teams to push the boundaries of what wearable technology can achieve. This is a unique opportunity for an electrical engineering expert who thrives in cross-functional environments and is passionate about using their expertise to shape the future of wearable technology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead systems engineering activities for wearable hardware programs, ensuring alignment between product requirements, system architecture, and technical execution.

  • Define, maintain, and manage system requirements, interface definitions, and technical documentation throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define and refine system requirements, focusing on seamless integration of Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Signal Processing, Manufacturing, and Product components.

  • Develop and execute verification and validation strategies to confirm alignment with system requirements, defining test protocols and success metrics.

  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing technical recommendations that improve system performance, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and drive cross-functional resolution throughout development.

  • Mentor engineers through hands-on technical guidance and leadership, with opportunities to take on people management responsibilities as the team grows.

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally to collaborate with partners, suppliers, and manufacturers.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in electrical systems engineering, hardware design, or a related domain.

  • Proven expertise in electrical system architecture and integration.

  • Strong cross-disciplinary understanding of electrical, firmware, and mechanical domains.

  • Analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on driving impactful, system-level decisions.

  • Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to creating and maintaining thorough, accurate, and well-organized documentation.

  • Strong communication skills to facilitate collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with schematic/layout reviews, and laboratory equipment for hardware bring-up, debugging, and validation.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor or manage engineers from diverse technical backgrounds.

WHOOP is seeking a highly skilled Staff Systems Engineer to join our Systems Engineering team within the hardware organization. This role is responsible for driving system architecture and technical strategy across current and future wearable platforms, partnering closely with Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Signal Processing, Product, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to deliver exceptional member experiences. As a senior technical leader, you will solve complex cross-disciplinary challenges, establish engineering best practices, and influence the long-term direction of WHOOP hardware through deep systems thinking and collaborative leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and drive system architecture across multiple hardware programs, ensuring alignment between product goals, technical feasibility, and long-term platform strategy.

  • Lead cross-functional technical decision-making across Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Signal Processing, Manufacturing, and Product teams to resolve complex system-level challenges.

  • Own the development and evolution of system requirements, interface definitions, and architecture documentation, ensuring traceability throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Develop system verification and validation strategies that confirm product performance, reliability, and compliance with system requirements.

  • Lead architecture and design reviews, providing technical guidance that improves system performance, scalability, manufacturability, and reliability.

  • Identify technical risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and influence product roadmaps through data-driven engineering recommendations.

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally to collaborate with partners, suppliers, and manufacturers.

  • 8+ years of experience in electrical systems engineering, hardware design, or a related domain.

  • Demonstrated experience defining system architecture for complex, highly integrated electronic products from concept through production, ideally in high-volume manufacturing environments.

  • Deep understanding of hardware system integration and V&V testing across electrical, firmware, mechanical, sensing, and algorithm domains.

  • Proven ability to lead technical direction across multiple cross-functional teams without direct organizational authority.

  • Experience developing system requirements, interface definitions, verification strategies, and validation plans for complex hardware systems.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer I
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. By delivering actionable insights and innovative hardware, WHOOP helps members achieve their goals and push the boundaries of human potential.

As a Mechanical Engineer on the Hardware Advanced Development Team at WHOOP, you will contribute to the design and development of WHOOP’s innovative hardware solutions. You will push the boundaries of technology by driving product innovation from conceptual prototypes to manufacturing-ready designs. You’ll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of engineers and designers to help bring innovative concepts to life, supporting prototyping, mechanical design, and testing efforts. This is a great opportunity for an engineer with a solid technical foundation to grow their skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while contributing to impactful projects in early-stage product development.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Contribute to mechanical design and development of early-stage projects to shape the future of WHOOP hardware.

  • Design, prototype, and test complex mechanical components around microelectronics, meeting stringent technical, performance, and industrial design requirements to guide projects from concept through manufacturing release.

  • Develop and present multiple design solutions for novel and complex technical challenges, articulating them clearly to cross-functional teams and documenting design process and specifications thoroughly.

  • Support the design and execution of comprehensive testing and validation plans, employing advanced design of experiments (DOE) methodologies to drive understanding, uncover insights, and deliver actionable results that enhance product quality, performance, and manufacturability.

  • Partner with the Hardware Product Team to lead engineering evaluation of new technologies, addressing risks that build confidence in NPI readiness.

  • Operate and maintain in-house prototyping tools, including 3D printers and CNC machines, to create proof-of-concept prototypes and support early-stage development.

  • Collaborate with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies and manufacturing methods.

  • Up to 10% travel to contract manufacturers and suppliers.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

  • 0-3 years of experience in the design of complex mechanical products, preferably for consumer electronics, wearables, or medical devices.

  • Experience with SolidWorks, or transferable CAD program

  • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping tools to craft proof-of-concept models.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working on cross-functional teams.

  • Working understanding of SolidWorks best practices, including advanced assemblies, surfacing, configuration management and applying DFx feedback.

  • Familiarity with validation testing methods and statistical analysis tools.

  • Experience with high-volume manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, sheet metal design, metal injection molding) and manual assembly.

  • Prior experience in high-quality consumer electronics or wearable technologies is preferred.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (Health Records)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Software Engineering Manager to lead the Health Records engineering team responsible for building the secure, scalable platform that powers ingestion, and utilization of clinical health data. This team enables WHOOP to integrate with external healthcare ecosystems and transform complex health records into meaningful insights that drive personalized experiences and improve long-term health outcomes for our members.

As an Engineering Manager III, you will be responsible for both technical and organizational leadership. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Security, and Platform Engineering to define the long-term technical strategy for Health Records while building and growing a high-performing engineering team. You will guide architectural decisions, foster operational excellence, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work while delivering reliable, secure, and scalable healthcare systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, continuous learning, and psychological safety.

  • Define and execute the technical strategy for WHOOP's Health Records platform, ensuring systems are scalable, reliable, secure, and extensible as new healthcare capabilities are introduced.

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver member-facing experiences powered by health record data.

  • Guide the architecture and evolution of systems responsible for ingesting, processing, governing, and exposing health record data from external healthcare ecosystems, including standards such as FHIR.

  • Establish engineering best practices around system design, operational excellence, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance for highly sensitive health data.

  • Drive execution through effective planning, technical prioritization, and cross-team collaboration while balancing long-term platform investments with product delivery.

  • Coach engineers and engineering leaders through career development, performance feedback, hiring, and succession planning while raising the technical bar across the organization.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms in production environments.

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing senior engineers and technical leaders.

  • Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and deliver complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, APIs, and operational excellence.

  • Experience building secure systems that manage sensitive customer or healthcare data; familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR is strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Product, Design, Data Science, and executive stakeholders to align technical investments with business outcomes.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across organizational boundaries.

  • Passion for building inclusive, high-performing engineering organizations and creating an environment where teams can thrive.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II (Backend, Health Records)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Software Engineer II (Backend, Health Records) to help build the systems that enable secure, scalable ingestion and utilization of health data. In this role, you will contribute to the infrastructure that connects external healthcare ecosystems with the WHOOP platform, transforming complex health records into meaningful, actionable insights. Your work will directly power personalized health experiences and expand WHOOP's ability to deliver long-term value to members.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the design and development of backend systems for ingesting and processing health record data from external sources (e.g., EHRs, third-party health platforms)

  • Build and support robust data pipelines to clean, normalize, and structure health record data for reliable downstream consumption

  • Develop and maintain secure, scalable APIs and services that expose health record data to internal systems and member-facing features

  • Apply best practices for data privacy, security, and access control when working with sensitive health data

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data science, and engineering teams to unlock new health insights and capabilities

  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure high-quality, maintainable systems

Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of experience building backend systems and APIs in production environments

  • Experience working with backend technologies such as Java (or similar), relational databases (e.g., Postgres), and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS)

  • Familiarity with designing and working with data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and validation of structured or semi-structured data

  • Understanding of API design principles

  • Exposure to healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, CDA) or integrating with external health data sources

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to break down technical tasks and deliver iteratively

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional environments

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

WHOOP is hiring a Research Manager to lead the Distributed Research team which owns large-scale decentralized data collections through Digital WHOOP Labs, powering research and innovation across WHOOP. In this role, you will define the team's strategy, mentor and develop a high-performing team of researchers, and partner closely with cross-functional research partners, Research Program Management, and Research Platform to prioritize work, scale distributed research capabilities, and continuously improve the tools and processes that enable high-quality data collection at scale. Your leadership will help expand WHOOP's ability to generate trusted, actionable data that accelerates scientific discovery, product innovation, and member impact.



Responsibilities:

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of researchers across multiple career levels, fostering technical excellence, career growth, and a high-performing team culture.

 - Define and execute the functional strategy for Distributed Research, driving the continued evolution and scaling of distributed research capabilities across WHOOP.

 - Partner closely with the Distributed Research Program Manager to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, balance team capacity, and deliver against organizational priorities.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders such as Machine Learning Research, Digital Health, and Performance Science to understand research objectives, scope research initiatives, and ensure successful execution.

 - Partner with the Research Platform team to improve the technologies and workflows that support distributed research, leveraging user feedback, operational insights, and evolving business needs to drive continuous improvements in scalability, participant experience, and data quality.

 - Monitor operational and team performance metrics, using insights to optimize execution, improve efficiency, and inform strategic decisions across the Distributed Research function.

 - Serve as an advocate for distributed research methodologies and survey science, educating cross-functional stakeholders on best practices and helping scale these capabilities across WHOOP.



Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of experience in remote study management, at-home trials, research operations, clinical research operations, digital health research, UX research, or a related field.

 - 2+ years directly managing and developing individual contributors. Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams through organizational growth and ambiguity.

 - Experience partnering closely with program management, product, engineering, scientific, or research platform teams to deliver complex cross-functional work.

 - Strong understanding of survey science and distributed research methodologies, with the ability to communicate the importance of survey design and other study considerations to diverse audiences.

 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.

 - Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II (Full Stack, Growth)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

The Growth team is responsible for accelerating member acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention through rapid experimentation and thoughtful product development. As a Software Engineer II (Full Stack), you will build and maintain the experiences and services that power WHOOP’s growth initiatives, working across the frontend and backend to deliver high-impact features that directly influence member and business outcomes. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and fellow engineers in a fast-paced, experiment-driven environment where iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement are core to how we build.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work within a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to design, build, and ship full stack features that improve member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention.

  • Develop and maintain frontend applications using modern web technologies

  • Build, maintain, and optimize APIs and infrastructure supporting our acquisition funnels, e-commerce experiences, and membership growth experiments.

  • Break down feature requirements into actionable tasks, prioritize work, and consistently deliver on sprint commitments.

  • Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve the reliability, quality, and maintainability of the platform.

  • Participate in code reviews and collaborate on best practices with your engineering peers

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience building production web applications.

  • Proficiency in web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, and React

  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a passion for building high-quality, user-focused products in an iterative, data-driven environment.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design teams.

  • A growth mindset and eagerness to learn from feedback and new challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Core)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our wearable technology monitors vital physiological metrics to offer personalized insights that enhance fitness, health, sleep, and recovery.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core team, you will build the foundations that power the WHOOP App and develop features that empower members to optimize performance and longevity. You will play a critical role in building and scaling the foundational systems that power the WHOOP member experience for fitness, sleep, strain, recovery, and integrations. You will partner closely with other engineers, product management, design, data science, and performance science to shape and build the polished member-facing experiences for these features.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of foundational backend capabilities that improve scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.

  • Drive technical planning for complex initiatives by defining scope, sequencing work, identifying risks, and communicating technical tradeoffs.

  • Deliver high-impact platform capabilities while balancing technical quality, business priorities, and data-informed engineering decisions.

  • Establish and evolve backend engineering standards through architecture discussions, code reviews, documentation, and technical leadership.

  • Mentor engineers and help grow the team's technical capabilities through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence engineering direction, and mentor other engineers.

  • Deep expertise in backend development, including Java, API design, distributed systems, and relational databases such as Postgres.

  • Experience designing scalable, reliable, and observable systems using cloud-native and event-driven architectures such as Kafka or SQS.

  • Strong engineering judgment with experience balancing technical quality, business priorities, and long-term maintainability.

  • Experience writing well-tested, maintainable software and establishing engineering best practices through technical leadership.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with technical and non-technical partners.

  • Enthusiasm in leveraging AI tools while maintaining high standards for quality and engineering excellence.

  • Bonus: Experience building shared platform capabilities or contributing across mobile and backend

jobs.title: Director of Product Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level and live longer through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Protecting our members’ data and ensuring our systems scale securely and reliably is core to this mission.

As a Director of Product Security you will play a critical role in shaping, driving, and leading our software engineering teams towards a secure software development lifecycle and strengthening product-facing identity and authentication capabilities that protect our members. This role will strategically craft the roadmap in collaboration with stakeholders across the business and staff the team to fulfill growing security needs across engineering.

In addition to core product security responsibilities, you will partner closely with functions across Product, Software, Legal, Compliance, and enterprise security to meaningfully move the security posture of the company. We are seeking a leader and strategic partner with prior experience driving the engineering side of security for software teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build, lead, and grow multiple engineering teams executing on product-facing security strategy, including member authentication, code security, cloud security across AWS accounts, privacy by design, and threat modeling.

  • Lead application vulnerability management programs across bug bounties, code vulnerabilities, container vulnerabilities, and infrastructure vulnerabilities.

  • Build, integrate, and mature DevSecOps tooling and developer security controls, including SAST, SCA, container scanning, secrets detection, CI/CD security checks, and secure-by-default developer workflows.

  • Define and communicate long-term product security strategy, product architecture standards, and design principles for product-facing systems.

  • Partner with engineering, office of the CISO, and compliance leadership to embed privacy and security by design across the software development lifecycle.

  • Establish and enforce best practices, standards, and processes for secure software development, testing, and deployment.

  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and career development for engineering managers and individual contributors.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, teamwork, psychological safety, and continuous learning within the Product Security organization.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated success scaling a security team whilst crafting clear and efficient team domains.

  • Proven experience as a technical leader managing multiple teams or a growing security engineering organization.

  • Experience growing high level individual contributor career growth at the staff level or higher.

  • Deep understanding of product security principles, including vulnerability management, data privacy, threat modeling, secure SDLC practices,and secure-by-default engineering patterns.

  • Experience building or integrating developer security tooling to improve secure-by-default practices.

  • Strong technical background in software development, testing, and deployment processes.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills with the ability to influence across teams and levels.

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with AWS cloud environments and data-driven decision-making.

  • Hands-on experience with containerized microservice environments.

  • Background in incident response and post-mortem analysis for security events.

  • Familiarity with automation frameworks for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, or infrastructure security.

ABOUT YOU

  • You’re a strategic and people-focused leader who thrives on balancing hands-on technical oversight with long-term organizational growth.

  • You have experience building and scaling security engineering focused teams.

  • You’re passionate about creating secure, privacy-first systems that protect member data and enable innovation.

  • You collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams and can operate confidently in both strategic and tactical domains.

  • Above all, you believe that security enables innovation, and you lead by fostering a culture that supports both speed and safety.

Learn more about our Software Org and how to be successful in your engineering career at WHOOP via our Career Framework.

 

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Wholesale Operations Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP
empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.


As a Wholesale Operations Analyst, you will support operational excellence across WHOOP’s wholesale and retail distribution network. You’ll play a key role in managing order execution, retailer operations, and 3PL coordination across global sales channels. This role is highly cross-functional and ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced operational environments, enjoys solving problems, and has a strong attention to detail. You’ll work closely with retail partners, third-party logistics providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate order processing, operational visibility, and a seamless retailer experience.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and monitor end-to-end order flow across assigned wholesale and retail channels, including processing and tracking retailer purchase orders between WHOOP systems, 3PLs, and retail partners.

  • Collaborate with 3PLs and internal teams to support inventory accuracy, transfer order receiving, and order adjustments.

  • Own day-to-day operational management for assigned international retail accounts, including retailer communication, shipment tracking, routing compliance, and operational issue resolution.

  • Maintain retailer operational requirements and portal compliance, including shipment documentation, tracking updates, routing guides, and retailer-specific operational inputs.

  • Support in-transit exception management by monitoring delayed, failed, or at-risk shipments and coordinating resolution across internal and external stakeholders.

  • Assist in developing and maintaining standardized operational documentation, including retailer SOPs, routing guidance, and process workflows.

  • Analyze operational performance and identify opportunities to improve order management, fulfillment execution, and inventory visibility.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years of experience in Operations, Supply Chain, or Logistics in a multi-channel consumer goods environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to interpret data and connect it to process improvements.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills are a must.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Bachelors degree or higher in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Battery Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, integration, and validation of battery systems for current and next-generation wearable products. You will work at the intersection of cell chemistry, battery pack architecture, electrical engineering, mechanical design, firmware, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain to deliver safe, reliable, and high-performing battery solutions. Through hands-on experimentation, rigorous data analysis, and cross-functional technical leadership, you will advance battery technology and strengthen engineering standards across the complete product development lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own battery subsystem architecture, requirements, integration, and validation from early concept development through new product introduction, mass production, and sustaining engineering.

  • Partner with Product, Battery Cell Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Firmware, and other cross-functional teams to translate product goals into battery requirements, energy and power budgets, consumption profiles, verification plans, and design documentation.

  • Lead the integration of charging systems, fuel gauging, protection circuitry, thermal sensing, firmware controls, telemetry, system power architecture, and mechanical battery design to optimize performance, safety, reliability, and member experience.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive design verification and qualification strategies, including design of experiments, accelerated life testing, reliability assessments, DFMEAs, design reviews, and pack- and system-level testing.

  • Lead structured root-cause investigations for development, manufacturing, and field issues, using test data, field telemetry, failure trends, and analytical tools to drive objective engineering decisions and continuous product improvement.

  • Partner with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, external suppliers, and third-party laboratories to evaluate specifications, qualify designs and processes, establish manufacturing controls, support regulatory compliance, and assess emerging battery technologies; travel up to 15% to engage with suppliers, manufacturing partners, and testing facilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrochemistry, or a related technical field, with 4+ years of relevant experience; an advanced degree with 2+ years of relevant experience will also be considered.

  • Strong understanding of lithium-ion cell chemistry, electrochemistry, battery pack behavior, degradation mechanisms, and the relationships among electrical, mechanical, thermal, and firmware systems.

  • Hands-on experience developing and executing test protocols for battery packs, electrical systems, printed circuit boards, or integrated hardware products.

  • Working knowledge of charging circuits, battery protection, fuel gauging, thermal management, battery management systems, and embedded firmware controls.

  • Experience using design of experiments, statistical analysis, accelerated life testing, reliability engineering, and structured failure-analysis methods to solve complex technical problems.

  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics, mechanical CAD models, tolerance analyses, engineering drawings, and GD&T callouts.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and technical communication skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, articulate engineering risks and trade-offs, and collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners; experience with space-constrained consumer electronics or high-volume battery manufacturing is preferred.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Corporate Counsel, Commercial to support the company's growing global business by providing practical, business-oriented legal guidance across a broad range of commercial matters. Reporting to the Associate General Counsel, this role will partner closely with teams across the entire organization to structure, negotiate, and advise on commercial transactions that help accelerate WHOOP's mission. This is an opportunity to help shape and scale the commercial legal function by building efficient processes, developing practical guidance, and enabling the business to move quickly while thoughtfully managing risk.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a wide variety of commercial agreements, including vendor, SaaS, technology, marketing, partnership, procurement, and services agreements.

  • Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables business objectives while appropriately managing legal and regulatory risk.

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable legal infrastructure, including contract templates, negotiation playbooks, self-service resources, workflows, and training that empower internal teams and increase efficiency.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline legal processes through automation, knowledge management, and the thoughtful adoption of technology, including AI-enabled tools.

  • Advise internal clients on legal issues arising from commercial relationships, including contract interpretation, intellectual property, data privacy, and compliance considerations.

  • Collaborate with the broader Legal team on strategic initiatives, product launches, and other cross-functional projects that support the continued growth of WHOOP.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.

  • 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience, including experience at a nationally recognized law firm and/or an in-house legal department supporting commercial transactions.

  • Experience drafting, negotiating, and advising on a broad range of commercial agreements with increasing levels of autonomy.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance legal risk with practical business considerations and deliver actionable advice in a fast-paced environment.

  • Interest in building and improving legal processes, playbooks, and operational infrastructure to support a scaling business.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across cross-functional teams.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Experience supporting technology, consumer products, healthcare, or subscription-based businesses is a plus.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Machine Learning, SaMD
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHOOP is on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. Our Health Machine Learning team develops the algorithms and models that power health features used by millions of members. This role exists to scale that work: building and leading the engineering and science teams that bring SaMD products from research through validation, submission, and production deployment.

As a Senior Manager, SaMD, you will own delivery and people outcomes across the machine learning engineers and applied ML scientists developing WHOOP's regulated health features. You will set direction for your teams, develop the next generation of leaders within the function, and partner deeply across regulatory, quality, clinical science, product, software, and firmware to deliver health products that meet a clinical-grade bar. You will be accountable for both the engineering velocity of your teams and the rigor required to operate inside a regulated medical device development environment (FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).

Success in this role requires a profile with both ML and SaMD depth to evaluate your team's most important decisions, plus the people leadership skill to grow ICs, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver with both pace and rigor in a regulated environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own delivery, team health, and people outcomes across multiple workstreams within ML SaMD team

  • Translate department strategy into clear quarterly plans, milestones, and success criteria; align the team on the highest-leverage work and adapt deliberately as the business evolves

  • Build the team: lead hiring at scale, calibrate the bar for regulated development, and shape onboarding, leveling, and growth practices

  • Develop the next layer of leadership, coach junior and seniorICs, manage performance with clarity and care, and create the conditions for people to operate above their level

  • Set the standard for how regulated ML gets built at WHOOP: methodology, work quality, validation rigor, and audit readiness

  • Partner directly with regulatory, quality, product, software, and firmware leaders to align on roadmap, dependencies, and submission timelines; broker trade-offs between iteration speed and regulatory rigor

  • Own the risk posture for your function; anticipate execution, technical, and regulatory risks, design mitigation into the operating model, and keep senior leadership clearly informed of the most consequential decisions

  • Define and own the operating model for your function; planning cadences, design reviews, decision forums, data governance, and quality gates appropriate to a SaMD context

  • Build and continuously raise AI-enabled workflows that create measurable leverage across the team; for development, evaluation, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder communication

  • Represent the team's work credibly to executive and cross-functional audiences with brevity, evidence, and clarity.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of experience in ML, applied science, or software engineering, with 3+ years managing engineering and/or science teams

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field

  • Demonstrated track record junior and senior ICs, including hiring, performance management, and developing people who in turn raise the bar around them

  • Deep familiarity with the ML development lifecycle: data collection, model training, evaluation, validation, deployment, and monitoring, sufficient to evaluate the most important technical and methodological decisions your team makes

  • Direct experience shipping algorithms or ML-enabled software in a regulated environment (Software as a Medical Device, medical device development, or comparable QMS-controlled product development under FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971)

  • Fluency operating across regulatory, quality, and clinical stakeholders, including familiarity with V&V, traceability, change control, design history, and audit readiness in fast-moving ML programs

  • Demonstrated ability to set strategy and make timely prioritization calls under uncertainty, keeping the team focused on the highest-leverage work

  • Demonstrated AI-tooling sophistication: a track record of building or adopting AI-enabled workflows that materially improved team speed, quality, or decision confidence

  • Clear, high-signal communicator who can move fluidly between deeply technical ML/regulatory discussions and executive-level summaries of risk, trade-offs, and direction.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

The AI team at WHOOP turns continuous physiological data into recommendations members act on every day. The quality of that intelligence is the product, and as it reaches more members across more surfaces, the work of measuring it, choosing the models behind it, understanding what it costs, and giving the rest of the company the tooling to build on it has grown into a role of its own.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Product Manager to work at that layer, alongside our AI engineers, research scientists, and data scientists. The work spans how AI output quality gets measured and enforced, which models and providers power which experiences, the internal AI platform that teams across WHOOP use to build agents, and which emerging techniques from the research world are worth a bet.

This is a platform-oriented AI product role. Your users are as often internal (agent authors, analysts, engineers, research scientists) as they are members. It suits someone technical enough to earn the trust of ML researchers, organized enough to run a program across several teams without direct authority, and disciplined enough to say no to most of what is possible.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Shape how AI output quality is measured across WHOOP's AI experiences, including the evaluation methodology, datasets, and scoring that make quality continuous and trusted rather than judged case by case.

  • Build the evaluation habit across the company: make evals self-serve, and get the teams shipping AI features to actually run them.

  • Help decide which models power which experiences, and which providers we run them on, balancing quality, latency, and cost as the model landscape shifts.

  • Product-manage our internal AI development platform and drive its adoption, so that anyone at WHOOP building with AI has a fast, well-instrumented path from idea to shipped.

  • Track the unit economics of AI at WHOOP, including cost per interaction, and drive the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and spend.

  • Explore where AI capability goes next, from fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to distillation and emerging foundation models, and turn a broad field of options into a small number of well-scoped bets, starting with internal productivity.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience shipping AI or machine learning products, where the underlying capability was probabilistic rather than deterministic.

  • Depth in evaluation and measurement: you have defined how something gets measured, not only reported on it.

  • Working literacy in modern ML: you understand what fine-tuning is and the main flavors of it, what RL-based post-training is for, and how the current generation of techniques fits together. You do not need to implement them, but you should know what they buy you and what they cost.

  • Experience with platform or internal-facing products, where the users are other teams.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to partner with research and engineering as a peer, and to translate model behavior into member experience.

  • A track record of driving cross-team programs with many dependencies and no direct authority.

  • Sound business judgment: you can quantify a tradeoff, reason about cost, and decline work that will not pay for itself.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, with evidence of turning a broad set of possibilities into one well-scoped bet.

  • Nice to have: internal AI tooling or evaluation frameworks; experience partnering with a research organization; wearables or sensor data; SQL or light scripting.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We’re looking for a Product Manager II to join the Growth Product team and own key areas of monetization across the WHOOP business. As WHOOP expands its membership offerings and product portfolio, this role will help define how we create and capture value across products and membership experiences — driving sustainable growth while delivering compelling experiences for members.

This is a highly analytical role at the intersection of product, growth, and business strategy. You’ll identify and size monetization opportunities, develop hypotheses about customer behavior and willingness to pay, build analytical business cases to inform roadmap prioritization, and translate those insights into product experiences and experiments. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, Marketing, and other Product teams to connect product decisions to measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate will have experience with mobile app development and consumer subscription businesses with multiple product lines, combining strong quantitative skills with customer empathy and product intuition to help evolve the WHOOP business model.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for key monetization experiences, with potential areas including pricing, promotions, upsells, membership plans, product bundles, and new business model opportunities.

  • Develop and prioritize the monetization roadmap using rigorous analytical business cases, balancing the size of the opportunity, customer impact, business value, level of effort, and strategic importance to determine where the team should invest.

  • Own and deeply understand monetization KPIs, using quantitative analysis of customer behavior, funnel performance, unit economics, and financial outcomes to uncover opportunities and make roadmap decisions that contribute to company growth goals.

  • Lead end-to-end product discovery, delivery, and iteration — partnering deeply with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, and Marketing to turn ambiguous monetization opportunities into scalable, high-impact customer experiences.

  • Design and run a rigorous experimentation program: form explicit hypotheses, structure A/B tests, evaluate trade-offs across conversion, revenue, retention, and customer value, and translate learnings into a compounding roadmap of wins.

  • Develop a deep quantitative understanding of customer behavior across the member lifecycle, using data and customer insights to identify patterns, segment opportunities, understand willingness to pay, size potential impact, and build compelling business cases for investment across multiple products and offerings.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3–5+ years of product management, growth, or related experience with a demonstrated track record of shipping consumer products or experiences that produced measurable business impact.

  • Strong experience developing and prioritizing product roadmaps, with demonstrated ability to build analytical business cases, quantify opportunities, evaluate competing investments, and translate insights into clear product priorities.

  • Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to independently structure complex analyses, develop a deep understanding of customer behavior, identify meaningful patterns in customer and business data, and translate those insights into product strategy and decisions.

  • Experience working with consumer subscription businesses with multiple product lines, offerings, or revenue streams, ideally including direct experience developing mobile app products.

  • Strong understanding of growth and monetization mechanics, with experience in areas such as pricing, promotions, upsells, subscription economics, experimentation, or business model development.

  • Strong product intuition and customer empathy paired with a rigorous, data-informed mindset; able to form explicit hypotheses, validate assumptions, and connect product decisions to outcomes such as conversion, revenue, retention, lifetime value, and unit economics.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to drive alignment across technical and non-technical partners, articulate trade-offs clearly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

    This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

     

    Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

     

    WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

     

    The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

     

    At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

     

    The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $125,000 - $170,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

     

    In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

     

    These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

     

    Learn more about WHOOP.
