jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Packaging
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers users to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer, Packaging to lead the design, development, validation, and manufacturing release of next-generation packaging systems for WHOOP products and accessories. You are a proactive engineer with strong problem-solving skills, technical creativity, and attention to detail. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and independently drive packaging design solutions with sound engineering judgement, balancing the user experience, quality, cost and scalability. You will collaborate closely with Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, Program Management, Product, Brand, and Creative. You will work directly with global suppliers and contract manufacturers to develop, qualify, and ramp packaging solutions into mass production.

WHOOP operates with urgency because our mission demands it. We build products for people who push their limits—and we hold ourselves to the same standard. If you’re energized by complex challenges, hands-on development, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to ship packaging at scale, this role will push you—and reward you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own packaging components and assemblies from concept through manufacturing release

  • Lead packaging design, development, qualification, and production ramp for WHOOP products and accessories.

  • Create SolidWorks CAD models and packaging structures to support design exploration, prototyping, manufacturing development, and qualification

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including 3D files, 2D drawings, BOMs, specifications, and Engineering Change Orders (ECOs)

  • Own component selection and BOM accuracy, balancing manufacturability, cost, quality, sustainability, and supply chain readiness

  • Partner with Industrial Design teams to translate visual design intent into manufacturable packaging solutions across structure, material, print, graphics, color and finish

  • Build prototypes and perform hands-on assembly for engineering evaluation, proof-of-concept development, design validation, and drive cross-functional decisions

  • Perform root cause analyses to identify and resolve design, manufacturing, quality, and field issues

  • Establish and improve packaging engineering best practices, documentation standards, and design review processes

  • Travel internationally up to 20%

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience developing packaging at scale, ideally for high volume consumer products or consumer electronics

  • Strong SolidWorks CAD experience in part design, assemblies, configuration management, drawing creation, and efficient integration of DFM feedback

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator for packaging dielines, graphic layout review, print documentation

  • Experience creating and maintaining detailed 2D drawings, BOMs, ECOs, and component-level documentation.

  • Experience working directly with domestic and overseas suppliers through development, tooling, qualification, production ramp, and ongoing production support

  • Experience designing packaging for high volume manufacturing, including automated and manual assembly processes

  • Strong knowledge of packaging materials such as paperboard, molded pulp, corrugate, labels, films, adhesives, trays, inserts, and protective structures

  • Working knowledge of print and graphic production techniques, including color and finish control, tolerancing, inspection criteria, and methods for maintaining consistency at scale

  • Skilled at hands-on prototyping, model making, assembly, and troubleshooting of packaging concepts

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across disciplines in a fast-paced environment.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

 

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000 - $195,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

 

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Hardware Lab Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Hardware Lab Manager to own and scale the hardware development lab that enables rapid product innovation from prototype through validation. In this role, you will lead the people, systems, and infrastructure that allow engineering teams to move quickly from build to insight, ensuring the lab operates as a high-throughput platform that accelerates hardware development rather than becoming a bottleneck. You will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Technical Program Management to prioritize resources, expand capabilities, and build the operational foundation that supports WHOOP's next generation of products.

Responsibilities

  • Own the hardware development labs, comprising electrical, mechanical, test and reliability engineering capabilities, ensuring it operates as a high-throughput system that accelerates product development from prototype through validation.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of lab technicians, fostering a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with Engineering Program Managers and engineering leaders to prioritize shared lab resources, balancing competing program needs and removing development bottlenecks.

  • Build and continuously improve scalable lab systems for scheduling, work intake, inventory, equipment tracking, and resource planning.

  • Own the lifecycle of lab infrastructure, including test equipment, mechanical prototyping tools, metrology systems, calibration, maintenance, and long-term capability planning.

  • Partner with Hardware Engineering, Product Integrity, Manufacturing, and external labs to support prototype builds, testing, and validation.

  • Establish and maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment through standardized processes, training, and documentation.

  • Manage the lab budget and plan future investments in equipment, tools, and infrastructure to support product development.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in a hardware development, test, or laboratory environment, including experience leading lab operations or technical teams.

  • Proven experience improving lab operations and enabling fast-paced hardware development across multiple programs.

  • Experience managing lab equipment, prototyping tools, metrology equipment, calibration, inventory, and safety programs.

  • Hands-on experience supporting hardware prototyping, debugging, and engineering test activities.

  • Strong communication, organization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Recovery Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP believes in the power of humans to transform how they feel, perform and age; we serve the aspiring.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Revenue Recovery Analyst to own and optimize strategies that protect and recover revenue across the member lifecycle. This role will focus on improving payment recovery, reducing device loss, and preventing scams and abuse while maintaining a high-quality member experience. You will use data to identify sources of revenue leakage, develop and test solutions, and partner across Product, Engineering, Finance, Membership Services, and other teams to drive measurable improvements in revenue recovery and loss prevention.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own key revenue recovery and loss-prevention metrics, including payment failure-to-success rate, device loss rate, and losses associated with scams and abuse

  • Develop and execute strategies to improve payment recovery, identifying opportunities across payment retries and recovery workflows

  • Identify the root causes and financial impact of device loss and develop scalable strategies to improve device recovery and reduce associated losses

  • Identify emerging patterns of scams and abuse, partnering cross-functionally to develop preventative measures that minimize financial loss while preserving a strong member experience

  • Build a rigorous testing and measurement framework to evaluate revenue recovery initiatives, quantify incremental impact, and continuously optimize performance

  • Assist in incident response for revenue-impacting events, coordinating cross-functional teams to rapidly assess impact, mitigate losses and resolve root causes.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, Membership Services, Legal, and other stakeholders to prioritize and implement initiatives that balance revenue recovery, risk mitigation, operational complexity, and member experience

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, revenue operations, fraud/risk, or similar field

  • Demonstrated experience using data and experimentation to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, and drive measurable business outcomes

  • Experience developing or optimizing strategies related to payment recovery, fraud and abuse prevention, loss prevention, or similar revenue-protection programs

  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to quantify the impact of revenue leakage and build compelling business cases for solutions

  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, or other stakeholders

  • Ability to balance revenue optimization and risk reduction with the member experience, applying sound judgment in ambiguous or rapidly evolving situations

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex problems and data into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

jobs.title: Sensor Intelligence Engineer II (Advanced Development)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is looking for an Engineer II to join the Sensor Intelligence Group (SIG), a cross-functional team collaborating across Hardware, Firmware, and Data Science. This role will focus on advancing WHOOP’s mission of integrating cutting edge sensors that deliver physiological insight into our products. Success in this role will require a deep understanding of physical sensing mechanisms, for example electrical, optical, or thermal, and development of the signal processing and algorithms needed to translate raw data into actionable feedback.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Become the subject matter expert of a sensor modality, responsible for constructing and managing performance requirements and design sensitivities

  • Process raw data and implement signal processing and algorithmic approaches to evaluate sensor performance and advance new product features

  • Design hardware and human studies to capture data sets that are required for sensor and feature development

  • Collaborate with Hardware and Firmware engineers to give feedback on prototype and product design

  • Clearly communicate technical learnings to a multifunctional audience so that the team can efficiently navigate through a complex decision space

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field; Master’s or PhD degree preferred

  • 3+ years of experience as a hands-on engineer or scientist with a focus on leading early stage sensor design from concept to completion

  • Experience with Python and or Matlab for data analysis, signal processing, machine learning

  • Familiarity with electrical and optical laboratory characterization equipment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Innovative, knowledgeable, and able to adapt to changing requirements while still producing quality algorithms with tight deadlines

Additional Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with multiphysics numerical modeling tools

  • A basic understanding of human physiology (eg. hemodynamics, thermoregulation, biochemistry)

  • Experience in the context of medical device development, requirements definition, risk assessment

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, partnering across internal teams and external collaborators to bring innovative products to life for WHOOP.

  • Partner with Supply Chain to validate product feasibility, lead times, and cost at defined stages of the product creation process, ensuring alignment prior to sourcing commitments

  • Translate consumer insights, market trends, and performance data into actionable product briefs and category-level recommendations that inform roadmap and portfolio strategy

  • Drive product positioning, naming, and core messaging in collaboration with cross-functional partners to ensure consistency across channels

  • Partner closely with go-to-market teams to ensure a seamless transition from product readiness to launch execution

You will work across the stack to deliver high-quality features, contribute to agent orchestration system architecture, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to create seamless and impactful user experiences. This role is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about building reliable, scalable applications and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work in a cross-functional team alongside product managers, designers, and data scientists to deliver end-to-end features

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable front-end and back-end systems using modern frameworks and cloud technologies

  • Design and build intuitive user interfaces and integrate them with robust backend APIs to deliver seamless member experiences

  • Contribute to feature ideation, technical design, and implementation, translating business requirements into scalable solutions

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, following best practices for performance, security, and reliability

  • Monitor, debug, and resolve production issues while continuously improving system performance and stability

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2–5 years of professional software development experience

  • Experience building and maintaining high-quality, performant web applications using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS

  • Experience designing and developing APIs (RESTful services preferred)

  • Experience building solutions leveraging Large Language Models

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to break down complex problems into manageable solutions

jobs.title: Tax Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP empowers users to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We are seeking a Tax Analyst to join our Tax team and support our growing global tax function. As a key member of the team, you will help support indirect tax compliance, registrations, audits, and special projects across the U.S. and international jurisdictions.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong analytical foundation who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, and learning new concepts. We are looking for a smart, detail-oriented professional who can develop expertise in indirect tax while helping build scalable processes and controls as WHOOP continues to grow.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the global indirect tax compliance process, including U.S. sales and use tax, VAT, GST, and other international indirect taxes

  • Analyze large datasets to support tax filings, reconciliations, audits, and special projects

  • Prepare and review data used in tax returns and ensure information is complete and accurate

  • Assist with tax registrations and ongoing compliance requirements in domestic and international jurisdictions

  • Support indirect tax audits, notices, refund claims, and tax authority inquiries

  • Partner with Accounting, Finance, Operations, and external service providers to gather information and resolve issues

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls, and automate recurring tasks

  • Assist with maintaining tax systems, reporting tools, and data workflows

  • Take ownership of assigned projects and independently investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1-3 years of experience in public accounting, tax, audit, consulting, or a related analytical role

  • Big 4 experience strongly preferred

  • CPA license or progress towards CPA license preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field

  • Advanced Excel skills with experience working with large datasets

  • Experience with Alteryx, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar data analytics tools is a plus

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new tax concepts and business processes

  • Experience with NetSuite, Stripe, Avalara, or other ERP and tax systems is a plus

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Commercial Analytics (Wholesale)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Analyst, Commercial Analytics to join the Commercial Analytics team and serve as a key analytics partner to our growing Wholesale business. In this role, you will translate data into actionable insights that inform channel strategy, maximize partner performance, and identify new opportunities for growth. You will own critical analysis and reporting across the channel and help build the analytical foundation needed to scale the business across regions and partner networks.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as a key analytics partner to the Wholesale team, analyzing performance across partners, products, doors, and geographies to identify opportunities that drive revenue and margin growth.

  • Own analysis of sell-in and sell-through performance, pricing, promotions, and partner economics to assess channel performance, inventory position, consumer demand, and future growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

As a Senior Clinical Scientist, you will independently own assigned clinical studies that support WHOOP’s clinical development, product innovation, and regulatory objectives. Operating with minimal oversight, you will translate clinical and product questions into rigorous research approaches, generate and interpret evidence from clinical, wearable, and real-world data, and communicate findings in a way that informs product decisions, regulatory strategy, and clinical evidence generation. This role requires someone who can lead their assigned workstreams, partner effectively across cross-functional teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Independently lead the design and development of clinical study protocols, evidence-generation plans, endpoints, study procedures, and statistical analysis approaches with minimal oversight. Ensure studies are scientifically rigorous and aligned with clinical, product, and regulatory objectives

  • Support and oversee key aspects of study execution, including feasibility assessment, study startup, data collection, data review, monitoring oversight, and study closeout. Partner with Clinical Operations, Data Management, and external vendors or sites as needed to ensure high-quality execution

  • Use statistical tools such as R, SAS, Python, Stata, or similar platforms to analyze clinical, wearable, and real-world datasets. Interpret results, identify trends and limitations, and generate actionable insights that support clinical, regulatory, and product decision-making

  • Conduct comprehensive literature reviews to inform study design, endpoint selection, statistical methodologies, product claims, regulatory strategy, and scientific positioning. Integrate external scientific evidence with WHOOP data to support clinical development goals

  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and quality of clinical data by implementing and reviewing appropriate quality control measures throughout the study lifecycle. Conduct quality checks on datasets, statistical outputs, tables, figures, listings, and scientific conclusions

  • Communicate complex clinical and statistical findings in clear, actionable terms to clinical, product, data science, regulatory, and executive stakeholders. Translate technical analyses into meaningful business, product, and clinical insights

  • Independently author and review clinical study reports, protocols, statistical analysis plans, literature reviews, clinical evidence summaries, regulatory submission sections, manuscripts, abstracts, and internal scientific memos. Ensure documentation is accurate, scientifically sound, and regulatory-compliant

  • CWork closely with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Legal teams to ensure clinical and scientific input is incorporated throughout the product lifecycle

  • Contribute to evidence-generation strategies and clinical documentation for regulatory submissions, including 510(k), De Novo, CE Mark, clinical evaluation reports, clinical study reports, and responses to regulatory questions

  • Lead or contribute to manuscripts, abstracts, posters, presentations, and other scientific communications for internal stakeholders, scientific conferences, peer-reviewed journals, and external collaborators

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced degree preferred in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Biomedical Engineering, Medicine, or a related field. Master’s, PhD, MD, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent experience strongly preferred

  • 6–9 years of experience in clinical research, clinical science, data analysis, epidemiology, medical device, digital health, SaMD, pharmaceutical, biotech, or real-world evidence settings

  • Demonstrated ability to independently design and lead clinical studies, including protocol development, endpoint selection, study methodology, statistical analysis planning, and clinical study report writing

  • Strong understanding of FDA regulations, ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, clinical trial design, and evidence-generation requirements for regulated or health-related products

  • Experience contributing to regulatory submissions or clinical evidence packages, such as 510(k), De Novo, CE Mark, clinical evaluation reports, clinical study reports, or related documentation

  • Proficiency in statistical software such as R, SAS, Python, Stata, or similar tools

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and clearly explain findings, limitations, and implications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing clinical study reports, regulatory documents, scientific manuscripts, abstracts, presentations, or internal research summaries

  • Ability to independently manage complex work streams, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight

  • Nice to have: Experience working with clinical data, wearable data, real-world data, observational datasets, or large-scale health datasets

  • Nice to have: Experience with software as a medical device, digital biomarkers, wearable sensors, remote patient monitoring, or consumer health technology

  • Nice to have: Experience with Snowflake or other large-scale data platforms

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with software validation, algorithm validation, and clinical performance evaluation for digital health or SaMD products

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

 

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $145,000 - $195,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

 

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

WHOOP is hiring a Manager, Performance Marketing to help execute and optimize global paid media programs that drive sustainable member growth. This role will work closely with Brand Media, Marketing Analytics, Creative, Marketing Strategy & Operations, Product, and Finance to improve campaign performance and maximize the impact of our marketing investments. The ideal candidate is an analytical, results-oriented marketer who is comfortable operating across multiple paid channels, translating performance data into actionable insights, and continuously testing new ways to drive efficient growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the day-to-day management and optimization of paid media campaigns across key acquisition channels (i.e. paid social, search / shopping, programmatic, emerging channels), making informed adjustments to budgets, audiences, bidding, and placements to drive efficient member growth

  • Manage channel budgets and forecasts while analyzing campaign performance to identify trends, optimize investment, and surface opportunities to improve CAC, ROAS, conversion, and overall marketing efficiency.

  • Build and maintain a structured testing roadmap across creative, audiences, messaging, and media tactics, translating test results into actionable recommendations and scaling successful approaches

  • Partner closely with Creative and Brand Media teams to translate performance insights into creative briefs and recommendations that improve the effectiveness of paid media

  • Develop recurring performance reporting and communicate key insights, learnings, and recommended actions to Marketing and cross-functional partners

  • Stay current on evolving media platforms, tools, and industry trends, proactively identifying and piloting new opportunities that could improve acquisition performance

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, growth marketing, digital acquisition, or a related discipline, with experience driving measurable business results

  • Hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing paid campaigns across multiple acquisition channels, such as paid social, paid search, video, or other digital platforms

  • Strong analytical skills with experience leveraging data to inform decision-making, measure performance, and prioritize opportunities

  • Demonstrated ability to build forecasts, manage budgets, and communicate business impact to senior stakeholders

  • Experience partnering effectively with cross-functional teams including Marketing Analytics, Product, Creative, Finance, Brand Media, and Engineering.

WHOOP is seeking a Senior Hardware Engineering Program Manager to drive the execution of hardware initiatives that enhance our member experience and product performance. This role will lead cross-functional projects that span from supply resiliency efforts to full electromechanical redesigns. You will play a vital role in scaling innovation from concept to launch in collaboration with hardware, manufacturing, firmware, and supply chain teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead hardware engineering projects from kickoff through launch, focusing on performance, cost, and quality improvements.

  • Drive the team to respond quickly to new supply chain shortages and to build resiliency into all programs.

  • Create and manage detailed project plans aligned with WHOOP goals, balancing timelines, resources, and risk mitigation.

  • Coordinate engineering builds and iterative development activities with internal and external manufacturing partners.

  • Facilitate effective cross-functional collaboration and communication, ensuring timely decision-making and alignment.

  • Proactively identify and manage project risks and dependencies, driving resolution of technical and organizational blockers

  • Own and refine WHOOP’s Continuous Improvement Engineering process to enhance project execution and reliability.

jobs.title: Staff Hardware Test Engineer (Manufacturing)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Staff Hardware Test Engineer (Manufacturing) to lead manufacturing test strategy and deliver scalable test solutions that ensure every WHOOP device meets the highest standards of quality and reliability. You will take ownership of complex manufacturing test challenges from high-level objectives through strategy, execution, and production outcomes. Working across Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, and Reliability, you will drive alignment on test strategy, influence product and manufacturing decisions, and deliver measurable improvements in test coverage, quality, yield, cycle time, and cost. You will also establish best practices, raise engineering standards, and mentor engineers across the team.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the architecture, development, validation, and deployment of automated test equipment (ATE), electrical test fixtures, and control systems for engineering validation, NPI, and mass production.

  • Develop and establish scalable automated test methodologies and applications using Python to validate electrical, functional, RF, and sensor performance on manufacturing lines.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Hardware, Firmware, Manufacturing, and Quality engineering teams to make tradeoffs around test coverage, product quality, cycle time, yield, cost, and schedule.

  • Lead complex and ambiguous manufacturing test investigations, structuring problems, identifying technical and operational risks, and driving cross-functional teams to root cause and resolution.

  • Own manufacturing test readiness and outcomes through factory bring-up and production ramp with manufacturing partners, including fixture qualification, calibration, correlation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

  • Analyze manufacturing and test data to identify systemic opportunities and deliver measurable improvements in yield, process capability, test coverage, quality, cycle time, and cost.

  • Establish manufacturing test best practices, methodologies, and standards that improve execution quality and scalability across programs.

  • Identify technical and execution risks proactively and drive mitigation strategies with engineering teams and manufacturing partners.

  • Contribute to product and manufacturing roadmaps by identifying test technology, infrastructure, and capability investments required for future products.

  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on test architecture, debugging, automation, and manufacturing test methodologies.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 10+ years of experience developing hardware test systems, automated test equipment, or manufacturing test solutions for high-volume consumer electronics or similarly complex products.

  • Demonstrated experience independently owning manufacturing test strategy and execution from product development through NPI, ramp, and mass production.

  • Proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives and drive outcomes across multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.

  • Deep understanding of electronics, instrumentation, measurement systems, and communication protocols such as UART, I²C, SPI, USB, Bluetooth, and NFC.

  • Experience designing electronic circuits and PCBAs using tools such as Altium Designer.

  • Strong proficiency in Python for developing automated manufacturing test applications; experience with C/C++ or other systems languages is a plus.

  • Extensive experience designing, validating, and debugging manufacturing test fixtures, instrumentation, and production hardware.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing test methodologies and data analysis, including test coverage, calibration, correlation, GR&R, process capability, yield analysis, and failure analysis.

  • Extensive experience working with CMs and JDMs, including factory bring-up, NPI, production ramp, and sustaining support.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions, align stakeholders, and communicate effectively across engineering, operations, and leadership.

  • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in manufacturing quality, yield, efficiency, test coverage, or cost.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices within a team.

  • Ability to travel up to 15%, both domestically and internationally.

  • Strong commitment to leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $180,000.00 - $215,000.00 Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

jobs.title: Staff Accountant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and extend healthspan. Through continuous health and performance monitoring, WHOOP empowers members to better understand their bodies and make informed decisions that improve their daily lives.

As a Staff Accountant, Corporate Accounting, you will play a key role in supporting the accuracy, integrity, and scalability of WHOOP's financial operations. You will support critical areas of the month-end close process, including fixed assets, accruals, prepaid expenses, expense management, and balance sheet reconciliations. This role offers broad exposure across the organization through partnerships with Marketing, Manufacturing, Legal, Operations, R&D, and Finance teams. This is an excellent opportunity to build a strong technical foundation, gain a deep understanding of WHOOP's business operations, and grow within a high-performing accounting team.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to learn, with a passion for problem-solving and leveraging technology to improve efficiency.

This role is based in Boston, MA. Candidates must be willing to relocate, if necessary, to work from our Boston office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support the month-end close process through the preparation of journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and monthly fluctuation analyses, helping ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial results.

  • Support the monthly marketing accrual process by gathering inputs from Marketing stakeholders and preparing accrual calculations related to campaigns, agency relationships, and partnerships with high-profile athletes, influencers, and brand ambassadors.

  • Maintain fixed asset accounting, including recording asset additions, placements, transfers, disposals, and monthly depreciation, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and R&D teams to support capital expenditure initiatives.

  • Prepare prepaid expense schedules and monthly amortization entries, reviewing vendor contracts and invoices to help ensure costs are recorded over the appropriate benefit period.

  • Support company-wide expense management processes, helping ensure accurate reporting, policy compliance, and scalable controls.

  • Support annual audits and quarterly reviews by preparing schedules and supporting documentation and assisting with responses to auditor inquiries.

  • Contribute to process improvement and finance transformation initiatives by supporting system implementations, documenting standard operating procedures, and leveraging automation and AI-driven solutions to enhance efficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • 1-3 years of accounting experience; public accounting experience is a plus

  • Foundational understanding of U.S. GAAP and core accounting principles.

  • CPA candidacy or interest in pursuing the CPA is a plus.

  • Strong Excel skills, with comfort working with large datasets.

  • Experience with NetSuite, Oracle, or a comparable ERP system is a plus.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with intellectual curiosity and a willingness to ask questions and learn.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and motivated by continuous improvement and process optimization.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company's long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 -$90,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate's specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role's requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Clinical Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

As a Staff Clinical Scientist, you will serve as a senior scientific leader responsible for shaping clinical evidence strategy across some of WHOOP’s most complex and high-impact health initiatives. You will independently lead clinical programs from early scientific exploration through validation and regulatory evidence generation, translating ambiguous clinical, product, and business questions into rigorous research strategies.

In addition to directly owning high-priority workstreams, you will establish scientific and methodological standards, provide technical guidance to other scientists, and influence decisions across teams. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, identify scientific risks and opportunities before they become blockers, and ensure that WHOOP’s clinical evidence is rigorous, actionable, and aligned with long-term product and regulatory strategy.

This role is ideal for an experienced clinical scientist who combines deep expertise in study design, statistics, clinical evidence generation, and scientific communication with the ability to influence strategy across a highly cross-functional organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide scientific leadership across complex clinical development and evidence-generation programs, defining research strategies that support WHOOP’s product, clinical, regulatory, and business objectives.

  • Independently design and lead complex clinical studies, including research questions, protocols, endpoints, study procedures, sample-size approaches, statistical analysis plans, and interpretation frameworks.

  • Translate ambiguous or novel product and clinical questions into rigorous research approaches, recommending study designs that balance scientific rigor, operational feasibility, regulatory requirements, timelines, and business needs.

  • Lead the scientific strategy for study execution from feasibility and startup through data collection, analysis, interpretation, and closeout, partnering closely with Clinical Operations, Data Management, CROs, investigators, and external statisticians.

  • Lead statistical strategy and analysis of clinical, wearable, and real-world datasets, critically evaluating methodology, assumptions, bias, missing data, sensitivity analyses, subgroup analyses, and limitations.

  • Establish scientific standards and provide expert review of study designs, statistical analysis plans, analyses, outputs, and conclusions generated by Clinical, Data Science, and external partners.

  • Lead literature reviews and evidence synthesis, integrating published research, WHOOP data, and real-world evidence to identify evidence gaps and inform product strategy, clinical claims, study design, regulatory strategy, and future research priorities.

  • Own or provide senior scientific oversight for protocols, statistical analysis plans, clinical study reports, clinical evidence summaries, regulatory submission sections, manuscripts, abstracts, and other scientific communications, ensuring accuracy, rigor, and regulatory defensibility.

  • Serve as a senior scientific partner to Product, Data Science, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Clinical Operations, translating clinical evidence into clear recommendations for product development, algorithms, claims, regulatory strategy, and member experience.

  • Raise the scientific bar across the Clinical organization by mentoring Clinical Scientists and Senior Clinical Scientists, identifying scientific risks and opportunities, and contributing to WHOOP’s longer-term clinical research and evidence-generation roadmap.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Biomedical Engineering, Medicine, or a related field; PhD, MD, PharmD, ScD, DrPH, or equivalent advanced scientific training preferred.

  • Approximately 9–12+ years of relevant experience in clinical research, clinical science, medical devices, digital health, SaMD, pharmaceutical, biotech, or related health research environments.

  • Demonstrated track record of independently leading complex clinical research programs from study design through analysis, interpretation, and reporting, including defining scientific approaches for ambiguous or novel questions.

jobs.title: Director, Security Engineering & Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is seeking a Director, Security Engineering & Operations to lead the teams responsible for enterprise security engineering and security operations. Reporting directly to the CISO and serving as a senior member of the Security leadership team, this leader will shape strategy, lead a growing team of managers, engineers, and analysts, and drive measurable security outcomes across a fast-moving technology environment.

This is a leadership role for someone who has successfully scaled security operations in complex, high-growth environments and brings strong security engineering experience. The right leader combines strategic judgment with strong technical depth, staying close enough to the work to set a high bar for engineering quality, guide critical technical decisions, and lead effectively through significant security events.

This leader will play a significant role in shaping the team, operating model, and technical roadmap as WHOOP scales, advancing capabilities across security engineering, detection and response, incident management, security automation, identity, cloud, endpoint, SaaS, data protection, and other enterprise security domains.

As WHOOP expands its use of AI across member-facing products, internal technology, and engineering, and continues to evolve its capabilities in health, this leader will help ensure security scales alongside the company's technology, data, regulatory, and threat landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Security Engineering and Security Operations, defining strategy, priorities, technical standards, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes across both functions.

  • Advance a risk and threat-informed detection and response program that connects priority threat scenarios to the telemetry, detections, investigation capabilities, response procedures, and operational controls required to address them, including identity-centric, data protection, and insider risk scenarios.

  • Lead security incident readiness and response, including escalation, incident command for significant events, cross-functional coordination, post-incident review, and accountability for follow-up actions.

  • Guide the engineering and operationalization of preventive and detective security controls across identity, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, infrastructure, data, AI-enabled systems, and other high-value enterprise environments, while setting a high bar for technical design, testing, documentation, maintainability, and lifecycle management.

  • Lead the security strategy and engineering approach for AI-enabled products and enterprise AI adoption, including access controls, sensitive data handling, model and application security, third-party integrations, tool and agent permissions, monitoring, auditability, and secure use of AI across the company.

  • Drive an outcome-oriented approach to security technology and managed services, maximizing the effectiveness of existing capabilities, making disciplined decisions about when to automate, build, buy, or use external partners, and holding security partners accountable to measurable outcomes.

  • Drive disciplined execution across the security engineering and operations portfolio through effective prioritization, roadmap and backlog management, capacity planning, metrics, ownership, and operating cadence.

  • Lead, coach, and develop managers, engineers, and analysts, setting clear expectations for technical quality, judgment, ownership, execution, and professional growth.

  • Strengthen collaboration across Product Security, Security Architecture, Platform, Fraud, Engineering, IT, GRC, Legal, Privacy, and other business functions, creating clear ownership and effective operating relationships across organizational boundaries.

  • Partner with the CISO on organizational design, workforce planning, hiring, and development of the capabilities required as the Security organization evolves, while providing clear, data-driven communication on security posture, operational performance, significant risks, and strategic priorities.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in information security, with deep experience in Security Operations and meaningful experience across Security Engineering in complex technology environments.

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including multiple years managing managers and senior technical individual contributors. This is not a first-time people leadership role. Demonstrated strength in hiring, coaching, performance management, organizational design, and raising the bar for team quality and execution.

  • Deep technical expertise in detection engineering, SIEM and telemetry strategy, incident response, and modern security operations, including experience leading significant security incidents.

  • Proven ability to drive disciplined execution across priorities, roadmaps, backlogs, metrics, and ownership, while maximizing existing capabilities before introducing additional technology.

  • Experience managing MDR, MSSP, or similar security partners and holding them accountable to measurable operational outcomes.

  • Experience securing AI-enabled products, enterprise AI adoption, or AI development environments, including risks related to sensitive data, models, agents, third-party services, access, and monitoring.

  • Strong judgment and relationship-building skills, with a track record of working effectively across technical, product, risk, legal, and senior leadership teams.

  • Experience in health technology or another sensitive-data environment is a plus.

    This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

     

    Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

    WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

    The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

    At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

    The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $220,000-$245,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

    In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

    These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Endpoint
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is building a deeply technical IT organization and is looking to add a Systems Engineer focused on endpoint engineering. As WHOOP evolves from a consumer tech company into a personal health company - it is imperative to secure our fleet of endpoints while also enabling a frictionless employee experience. Doing both of those things well requires deep technical expertise, creativity, and a remarkably high bar for the quality of experience you’ll push onto your colleagues.

We need this role to work across both Mac and Windows ecosystems. Applicants should have top quartile expertise in at least one ecosystem.

As an early member of a growing and highly dynamic team, candidates must be ready and excited to take on significant responsibility, embrace ambiguity, and help define what world-class IT Security capabilities look like at WHOOP.

This role will collaborate closely with Security, Risk & Compliance, Software and Hardware Engineering, Business Systems, IT, and more. This is a high-impact role with a broad scope, and we have a mountain of work to accomplish. We want to attract someone who is motivated by the challenge and energized to solve tricky problems with the best tools available.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage our Mac and Windows fleets end-to-end

  • Craft a frictionless device lifecycle from unboxing to disposition

  • Implement and manage robust security policies in line with strict HIPAA standards

  • Manage the way we patch endpoint vulnerabilities in line with our committed SLAs

  • Engineer processes to do the things above in a way that minimizes employee friction and workflow disruption

  • Mentor colleagues to develop their endpoint skills & capabilities

  • Eliminate root causes of IT support tickets and manual IT toil

  • Contribute meaningfully in helping us build AI-first IT operations

  • Develop monitoring, observability, and reporting capabilities

  • Communicate proactively and clearly with employees and business partners, ensuring alignment and transparency around our plans and the trade-offs we’re making

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proven experience working on technically innovative systems and processes from the ground up

  • Strong engineering and programming skills to enable automation and custom solutions

  • Hands-on administration experience with MDMs

  • Experience managing large fleets of computers and other corporate-owned devices

  • Experience contributing to large-scale implementations and/or migrations of critical IT systems

  • Experience developing AI solutions to improve productivity or employee experience

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Strong judgment in prioritization and solution design, balancing impact and maintenance costs

  • Ability to work independently and take initiative in a rapidly changing environment

  • A demonstrated employee-first mindset, actively listening and engaging with users and making their lives better

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Vice President of Hardware Quality to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of quality across our global hardware ecosystem. This leader will be responsible for ensuring quality is embedded throughout the product lifecycle — from early product development through manufacturing, supplier management, and field performance. Working closely with Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Membership Services, Finance, and manufacturing partners, you will build scalable systems, drive operational excellence, and create a culture of continuous improvement that enables WHOOP to deliver exceptional products and member experiences at scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and execute a comprehensive quality strategy spanning product quality, manufacturing quality, supplier quality, field quality, and containment across the hardware lifecycle.

  • Build, lead, and develop a world-class global quality organization that enables operational excellence and unlocks growth and scale.

  • Partner closely with Hardware Engineering and Product Development teams to ensure robust quality planning, validation, and risk mitigation throughout new product introduction and sustaining engineering activities.

  • Establish quality metrics, operating mechanisms, and executive reporting frameworks that provide visibility into quality performance, risks, and opportunities across the supply chain.

  • Drive closed-loop quality improvement initiatives by connecting field performance, reliability testing, manufacturing data, supplier performance, and product design insights.

  • Lead supplier quality programs, including qualification processes, factory audits, corrective and preventive actions, and strategic supplier development efforts across a global manufacturing network.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in hardware quality, manufacturing quality, supplier quality, or related functions supporting consumer electronics, wearable technology, or other complex hardware products.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing quality organizations in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Deep understanding of consumer electronics manufacturing processes, including electro-mechanical assemblies, PCB/SMT manufacturing, batteries, plastics, and critical component qualification.

  • Experience working with global manufacturing and supplier partners and managing quality across geographically distributed operations.

  • Expertise in quality systems and methodologies, including statistical process control, auditing, corrective and preventive action programs, root cause analysis, FMEA, Design for Manufacturing, Lean manufacturing, and Six Sigma principles.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decisions through data-driven insights and cross-functional partnership.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% internationally to support manufacturing partners, suppliers, and quality initiatives.

Reporting to the Vice President of Hardware Quality, you will translate the broader quality strategy into scalable programs, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes that improve product quality and the member experience. You will connect field performance, member feedback, failure analysis, manufacturing and supplier data, and product insights to identify emerging risks, drive root cause and corrective action, and ensure learnings from the field influence future product and process decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring both deep quality expertise and the ability to lead through others. You will build and develop a high-performing team, establish clear quality metrics and escalation mechanisms, and partner across Supplier Quality, NPI Quality, Hardware Engineering, Accessories and Apparel, Reliability Engineering, Supply Chain, Global Operations, Membership Services, and our manufacturing and supplier network to drive continuous improvement across the WHOOP product ecosystem.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the field quality strategy and execution across Hardware and Accessories & Apparel, establishing KPIs, operating mechanisms, and cross-functional programs that identify emerging quality issues, prioritize risk, and drive measurable improvements in field performance and member experience.

  • Own the Failure Analysis function, Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) program, and Quality Lab, establishing scalable processes and technical capabilities to rapidly characterize failures, determine root cause, and translate findings into actionable design, manufacturing, supplier, and process improvements.

  • Build a closed-loop quality system connecting the field back to product development and manufacturing, synthesizing field returns, member feedback, reliability results, manufacturing trends, supplier performance, and failure analysis insights to identify systemic issues and influence upstream quality strategy and product decisions.

  • Lead cross-functional resolution of complex and high-impact quality issues, partnering with Analytics, Supplier Quality, NPI Quality, Hardware Engineering, Accessories and Apparel, Reliability Engineering, Supply Chain, Global Operations, Membership Services, contract manufacturers, and suppliers to establish containment, root cause, corrective and preventive actions, and verification of effectiveness.

  • Establish data-driven field quality management and executive visibility, defining metrics, escalation criteria, and review mechanisms in partnership with Analytics that enable teams and leadership to understand quality performance, make informed trade-offs, anticipate risk, and focus resources on the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Field Quality and Failure Analysis team, setting clear priorities and performance expectations, developing technical and leadership capability, and creating scalable systems that enable the organization to operate with increasing autonomy, speed, rigor, and accountability.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of experience in field quality, quality engineering, failure analysis, reliability, manufacturing quality, or a related discipline supporting consumer electronics, wearable technology, apparel/accessories, medical devices, or other complex consumer products.

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex quality programs across multiple products or product categories, with the ability to translate broad quality objectives into clear priorities, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.

  • Deep expertise in structured problem-solving and failure analysis methodologies, including root cause analysis, 5 Why, 8D, FMEA, DOE, Pareto analysis, CAPA, and related quality tools.

  • Experience building or leading failure analysis capabilities and laboratories, including the effective application of analytical techniques and equipment to characterize product failures and drive root cause determination.

  • Strong analytical acumen with experience using field performance, return, manufacturing, supplier, and customer/member data to identify trends, assess risk, prioritize investigations, and influence decisions.

  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence technical and business stakeholders across Engineering, Product Development, Operations, Supply Chain, manufacturing partners, and suppliers in a fast-paced global environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

jobs.title: Staff Android Engineer, Connectivity
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers people to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. We handle massive amounts of data continuously streaming up to the cloud from people improving their health and wellness to the world’s greatest sports teams and athletes mandating a fault-tolerant and highly available product.

The Connectivity team focuses on bridging the gap between embedded and mobile engineering, ensuring a seamless and consistent experience for members wearing a WHOOP strap. As a Staff Android Engineer on the Connectivity team you'll own the architecture of the software that connects WHOOP hardware to the Android app, and set the technical direction for how that connection performs at scale. From ensuring timely firmware updates to designing innovative ways to establish connections from software to hardware, we bring WHOOP to the highest level of performance and availability across the globe using the latest cutting edge technology. At the Staff level, your impact is measured as much by the engineers and decisions you influence as by the code you write.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the architecture of the Android connectivity layer end to end, from the BLE transport up through history sync and firmware delivery, and drive its evolution across a large modular codebase

  • Collaborate within a cross-functional environment alongside WHOOP hardware, firmware, and software teams

  • Establish and refine communication protocols between the WHOOP strap and Android, ensuring alignment with iOS standards

  • Apply expert-level mastery of the Android Bluetooth stack to manage GATT operations, bonding, and reconnection logic in real-world scenarios

  • Own connection reliability across the fragmented Android device landscape by diagnosing and mitigating OEM specific Bluetooth, power management, and permission behavior

  • Create and own systems that aid in analyzing connectivity health of our members, and use that telemetry to set team priorities

  • Manage a prioritized backlog centered on reducing technical debt, improving code health, and enhancing module testability

  • Elevate engineering quality through rigorous code reviews, expanded test coverage, and refined architectural design practices

  • Utilize expert Kotlin proficiency to build product features and define patterns for the broader engineering team

  • Document new features and architecture using Jira, Confluence and preparing code using Github feature, develop, and master branches

  • Participate in the incident commander rotation for the whole WHOOP ecosystem and also the release process including getting the app built, managing build variants, signing, sending and testing through Firebase, and submitting to the Play Store

  • Analyze and monitor user metrics and feedback to determine crash rate or potential bugs and to improve engagement

  • Represent Android Connectivity in cross-functional forums, including bug triage, product syncs, and firmware coordination

  • Facilitate the ramp-up of mobile developers, mentor engineers across the Android organization, and assist the backend team with data contracts

Who you are:

  • You are experienced working with consumer-facing apps that control BLE devices.

  • You have a track record of influencing engineers beyond your own team in the application of architectural and platform design principles

  • Expert knowledge of best practices for concurrency and multithreading, including Kotlin coroutines and Flow

  • Product minded engineer with empathy for the member experience

  • Willingness to learn and grow rapidly across Android and external systems

  • Extensive experience building, testing, debugging, and delivering native Android apps in a professional environment

  • Expert knowledge of Android application structure and components as well as lifecycle and Android Design Guidelines

  • Strong experience with Jetpack Compose and modern declarative Android UI

  • Experience with Kotlin and frameworks such as Koin, Android Jetpack libraries (including ViewModel, Flows, and Navigation), Room database, and Retrofit / OkHttp

  • Experience designing modular architecture and dependency boundaries in a large multi-module Gradle codebase, including patterns such as MVI and MVVM

  • Excellent knowledge of Android Studio, Gradle and CI systems

  • Experience debugging and diagnosing issues across complex or distributed systems such as firmware, mobile, and backend

  • Experience using Git to organize feature work

  • Experience communicating with a RESTful backend

  • Firm belief that automated testing is important and experience writing both Unit and UI tests

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, driving cross functional problem solving, tradeoff definition, and optimization

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Sensing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives, turning physiological data into trusted insight that helps guide everyday decisions.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the evolution of the foundational algorithms that turn sensor data into trusted physiological measurements. In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for core measurement capabilities that underpin the WHOOP experience, with a focus on accuracy, robustness, and performance in the real world.

You will work at the intersection of product, signal processing, machine learning, research science, hardware, and engineering to identify the most important opportunities to improve our algorithms, establish a high bar for performance, and translate technical advances into meaningful improvements for members. Your work will strengthen the foundation behind WHOOP experiences across Strain, Recovery, Sleep, Healthspan, coaching, and beyond.

Responsibilities:

  • Define what best-in-class sensing means for WHOOP and own the strategy and roadmap to make our foundational algorithms more accurate, reliable, and robust across the full range of real-world conditions.

  • Establish clear success criteria and make thoughtful tradeoffs across accuracy, coverage, responsiveness, power, and member experience.

  • Lead cross-functional strategy of sensing capabilities at WHOOP across Sensor Intelligence, Machine Learning, Hardware, and Embedded, driving alignment on priorities, technical tradeoffs, validation, and launch readiness.

  • Build a deep understanding of where our sensing performs well and where it breaks down, using field data, controlled validation, member feedback, and competitive benchmarking to identify the highest-impact opportunities for improvement.

  • Turn advances in sensing into meaningful member value, working across Product to ensure improvements in our foundational signals unlock better experiences across WHOOP.

  • Shape the future of sensing at WHOOP by identifying new algorithmic and technical capabilities that can expand what we can measure, improve how well we measure it, and create new opportunities for the product.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally building technically complex products in consumer health, wearables, sensing, machine learning, or adjacent domains.

  • Experience working with sensor data, algorithms, or quantitative models, with the technical fluency to engage deeply with engineering and scientific teams on performance, failure modes, validation, and system tradeoffs.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort working directly with data to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make informed product decisions.

  • Exceptional product judgment, with the ability to balance scientific rigor, technical complexity, member impact, and speed of execution.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguous, technically challenging problems, creating clarity and alignment across disciplines with different perspectives and constraints.

Your work will strengthen the foundation behind WHOOP experiences across Strain, Recovery, Sleep, Healthspan, coaching, and beyond.

Responsibilities:

 - Define what best-in-class sensing means for WHOOP and own the strategy and roadmap to make our foundational algorithms more accurate, reliable, and robust across the full range of real-world conditions.

 - Establish clear success criteria and make thoughtful tradeoffs across accuracy, coverage, responsiveness, power, and member experience.

 - Lead cross-functional strategy of sensing capabilities at WHOOP across Sensor Intelligence, Machine Learning, Hardware, and Embedded, driving alignment on priorities, technical tradeoffs, validation, and launch readiness.
