 - Turn advances in sensing into meaningful member value, working across Product to ensure improvements in our foundational signals unlock better experiences across WHOOP.

 - Shape the future of sensing at WHOOP by identifying new algorithmic and technical capabilities that can expand what we can measure, improve how well we measure it, and create new opportunities for the product.

 - Experience working with sensor data, algorithms, or quantitative models, with the technical fluency to engage deeply with engineering and scientific teams on performance, failure modes, validation, and system tradeoffs.

 - Strong analytical instincts and comfort working directly with data to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make informed product decisions.

 - Exceptional product judgment, with the ability to balance scientific rigor, technical complexity, member impact, and speed of execution.

 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguous, technically challenging problems, creating clarity and alignment across disciplines with different perspectives and constraints.

 - Strong communicator who can translate complex technical concepts into clear product decisions and compelling narratives for a broad range of audiences.

 - Passion for building products that help people better understand their bodies through accurate, trusted, and meaningful data.

jobs.title: Manager, Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP empowers

members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies

and daily lives.

As a Manager of Governance, Risk, and Compliance you will lead the day-to-day

execution and support the ongoing operation of the GRC program in a fast-paced,

high-growth environment. This role is responsible for hands-on execution of GRC

initiatives, collaborating across Legal, Security, Product, and other teams to advance

compliance objectives, reduce enterprise risk exposure, and strengthen operational

resilience.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the GRC function, ensuring timely execution of governance, risk, compliance, third-party risk, and secure development lifecycle (SSDLC) assessment activities.

  • Lead enterprise risk reviews by driving GRC intake and request triage, personally overseeing complex assessments while prioritizing and delegating work across the team.

  • Perform and lead the third-party risk management lifecycle by conducting and overseeing vendor risk assessments and due diligence in partnership with Legal, IT, and Security.

  • Manage team workload and capacity by assigning, tracking, and escalating requests as needed to ensure consistent delivery, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction.

  • Develop and report operational metrics and KPIs, providing weekly dashboards and status updates to GRC leadership.

  • Contribute directly to governance activities, including policy management, control assessments, evidence collection, audit support, and continuous compliance initiatives.

  • Maintain the enterprise risk register by documenting, tracking, escalating, and reporting technology, cybersecurity, privacy, and third-party risks

  • Support security incident response activities by coordinating compliance-related obligations, regulatory documentation, and risk remediation tracking.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of experience in GRC, information security, cybersecurity; with 2+ years of experience leading or managing GRC, information security, or audit professionals.

  • Demonstrated experience leading operational GRC programs, including intake management, workload prioritization, KPI reporting, and cross-functional coordination.

  • Extensive hands-on experience performing third-party/vendor risk assessments, security reviews, due diligence, and risk-based decision support.

  • Strong knowledge of SSDLC risk assessments and application security governance processes.

  • Deep knowledge of security and privacy frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, and modern cybersecurity risk management practices.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, auditors, and executive leadership

  • A minimum bachelor’s degree in any discipline. Computer science, cybersecurity, and risk or technology degrees preferred.

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CRISC, CISA, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

  • Demonstrated success in program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Background in establishing SSDLC guardrails.

ABOUT YOU

  • You are a risk focused GRC leader with ability to assess security risks and translate it into business impact.

  • You have the ability to assess a risk impact in terms of business trade-offs.

  • You are passionate about building scalable GRC programs that have a lasting impact in improving the overall security posture of an organization without slowing the speed of innovation.

jobs.title: Retail Experience Design Specialist I
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.


WHOOP is seeking a Retail Experience Design Specialist I to help bring the WHOOP brand and product experience to life across physical retail environments. As a member of the Retail team, you will support the design and development of engaging, functional, and distinctly WHOOP spaces that introduce consumers to our products and create memorable brand experiences.


In this role, you will apply your architectural training and design skills to help translate creative concepts into thoughtful physical environments. You will work cross-functionally with Retail, Brand, Creative, Operations, and other partners throughout the design process—from early concepts and spatial planning through design development, documentation, production, and installation.


The ideal candidate is a recent Master of Architecture graduate with strong spatial and visual design skills, a high level of attention to detail, and an interest in applying an architectural design background to retail and experiential environments. You are curious, collaborative, comfortable working through ambiguity, and excited to develop your craft in a fast-paced environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the design and development of WHOOP retail environments, including stores, shop-in-shops, pop-ups, fixtures, displays, merchandising elements, signage, and other physical brand touchpoints.

  • Translate WHOOP brand principles and creative concepts into compelling spatial experiences that balance aesthetics, functionality, product storytelling, and the customer journey.

  • Develop architectural and spatial design concepts through sketches, plans, elevations, 3D models, renderings, material studies, and presentations.

  • Support space planning and layout development, considering customer flow, product interaction, merchandising, accessibility, and operational requirements.

  • Create and maintain design documentation that clearly communicates design intent to internal stakeholders, vendors, fabricators, and other external partners.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams across Retail, Brand, Creative, and Operations to understand project requirements and translate business and customer needs into physical design solutions.

  • Participate throughout the design process, from early concept development and design iteration through production, installation, and launch.

  • Assist in the research and selection of materials, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, signage, and other environmental elements appropriate for WHOOP retail experiences.

  • Support prototype development and design reviews, incorporating feedback and helping refine solutions based on feasibility, cost, schedule, and customer experience.

  • Collaborate with vendors, fabricators, and external partners to communicate design requirements, review samples and prototypes, and help ensure final executions align with design intent and WHOOP quality standards.

  • Help develop and maintain retail design standards, guidelines, templates, and documentation that create a consistent WHOOP experience across different locations and formats.

  • Stay informed on trends and innovations across architecture, retail, experiential design, materials, fabrication, and consumer environments, bringing relevant ideas and inspiration back to the team.

  • Manage multiple projects and design deliverables simultaneously while maintaining a high level of organization, accuracy, and attention to detail.

  • Travel up to 10% domestically and internationally to support site visits, installations, retail openings, vendors, and project partners.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master of Architecture (M.Arch) degree or BArch (Professional) required.

  • 0–2 years of professional, internship, or relevant project experience in architecture, retail design, experiential design, environmental design, or a related discipline.

  • Portfolio demonstrating strong architectural and design thinking, spatial problem-solving, visual communication, and an ability to translate concepts into compelling physical environments.

  • Strong understanding of architectural design fundamentals, including space planning, scale, proportion, circulation, materials, and detailing.

  • Proficiency with architectural design and 3D modeling, including Rhino; visualization tools, including KeyShot and Enscape; and presentation tools, including Figma. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop.

  • Ability to develop and communicate ideas through sketches, plans, elevations, diagrams, 3D models, renderings, and presentations.

  • Strong visual sensibility and understanding of how materials, color, lighting, graphics, product, and architecture work together to create a cohesive physical experience.

  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate, thoughtful, and high-quality design work.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design ideas and rationale to a variety of audiences.

  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across creative, operational, and technical teams and incorporate feedback into the design process.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to balance multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Self-motivated, curious, and comfortable learning quickly and operating in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passion for architecture, retail and experiential design, consumer experiences, and the intersection of physical space, technology, fitness, and wellness.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

WHOOP is seeking a Senior NPI Quality Engineer, (Hardware) to lead Product Quality for a portfolio of hardware development programs from concept through launch. As a technical leader within the Product Quality organization, you will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Reliability, Operations, and global manufacturing partners to ensure products are designed, validated, and launched with exceptional quality. You will own quality planning, risk management, launch readiness, and product quality execution across multiple complex hardware programs while helping establish the standards and operating mechanisms that define Product Quality at WHOOP.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own Product Quality for multiple hardware development programs, ensuring products progress through development with robust quality planning, risk management, validation, and manufacturing readiness.

  • Partner with Product Management and Systems Engineering in transforming ambiguous and broad Voice of Customer requirements into quantifiable specifications via Product and Engineering Requirement Documentation.

  • Partner with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Field Quality, Reliability, Test Engineering, Operations, and manufacturing partners to design quality in the product by identifying failure modes and identify quality risks early in the product development process and drive timely resolution throughout product development.

  • Lead quality planning activities including DFMEA, CTQ definition, reliability planning, validation and verification strategy, process capability, measurement system analysis, and launch readiness reviews.

  • Partner with Supplier Quality to drive quality excellence across the supplier network and contract manufacturers via engineering drawings and design files review, robust quality control plan and process capability improvement

  • Drive structured problem solving using data-driven methodologies and statistical engineering to investigate product and manufacturing risks, implement corrective actions, and continuously improve product quality across development programs.

  • Represent Product Quality in cross-functional program reviews, communicating quality status, launch readiness, key risks, and mitigation plans to engineering and operations leadership.

  • Contribute to the evolution of WHOOP's Product Quality systems, standards, metrics, and operating mechanisms while mentoring peers and helping raise the technical bar across the Product Quality organization.

  • Willingness and able to travel up to 15% internationally to partners, suppliers, and contract manufacturers

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Quality, NPI Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Product Engineering, or related roles supporting consumer electronics, wearables, medical devices, or similarly complex hardware.

  • Experience leading quality for complex hardware products through development, validation, manufacturing readiness, and product launch.

  • Strong knowledge of quality methodologies including DFMEA, PFMEA, CTQ, DOE, SPC, MSA, GR&R, root cause analysis, CAPA/8D, and statistical quality methods.

  • Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturing partners in high-volume manufacturing environments.

  • Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence technical decisions through objective data and structured problem solving.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment while managing multiple programs and competing priorities.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Lead, Lifecycle Marketing Automation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

 

WHOOP is hiring a Lead, Lifecycle Marketing Automation to join our Lifecycle Marketing Operations team within Growth. This individual contributor will help build the technical foundation that powers how WHOOP communicates with members at scale. You will translate lifecycle strategies and business needs into sophisticated, personalized experiences across our marketing technology stack while helping evolve our approach from manual campaign production toward scalable automation and AI-powered workflows.

 

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems at the intersection of marketing, technology, and data. You will help shape how WHOOP uses platforms including Hightouch and Iterable, along with emerging technologies, to orchestrate member communications, enable new channels and markets, improve operational efficiency, and build the next generation of Lifecycle Marketing capabilities.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and deploy sophisticated lifecycle experiences across email, push, in-app, SMS, WhatsApp, and emerging channels, translating business requirements into scalable audiences, triggers, journey logic, personalization, and automated workflows.

  • Own hands-on technical campaign development, including complex HTML and CSS email builds, reusable templates and components, responsive email development, and dynamic personalization using Handlebars, Liquid, and other templating logic.

  • Own technical implementation across the Lifecycle Marketing technology stack, including audience activation and segmentation in Hightouch, campaign orchestration in Iterable, SQL-based data validation, integrations, APIs, webhooks, and other technologies that power member communications.

  • Build scalable automation and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual campaign production, increase execution speed, and improve quality. Explore, evaluate, and operationalize emerging technologies and capabilities, including agentic campaign development, AI-generated content, and automated quality assurance.

  • Establish and continuously improve technical and operational standards across campaign development, quality assurance, data validation, localization, privacy and compliance, troubleshooting, documentation, platform governance, and reusable development practices.

  • Partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Creative, and other teams to translate complex business and member needs into technical solutions, independently troubleshoot issues, and identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across WHOOP communications and the product.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing automation, marketing technology, CRM operations, marketing operations, or a related technical marketing role, with significant hands-on responsibility for building and maintaining automated customer experiences.

  • Deep hands-on experience with a customer engagement or marketing automation platform such as Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or a comparable platform, including complex journey orchestration, segmentation, personalization, and multi-channel campaign execution. You understand the underlying principles of marketing automation and can adapt quickly across platforms and technologies.

  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS email-development, including responsive design, reusable templates, troubleshooting across email clients, and building sophisticated dynamic content using Handlebars, Liquid, or comparable templating languages.

  • SQL proficiency and experience working with customer data and audience activation technologies such as Hightouch, Census, Segment, or similar platforms, with a strong understanding of event-driven data, customer attributes, segmentation, and how data moves between systems.

  • Technical experience working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, integrations, and data-driven marketing systems, with the ability to independently investigate and troubleshoot campaign, platform, integration, and data issues.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for automation and build scalable solutions that reduce repetitive manual work. Experience experimenting with or applying AI, generative AI, or agentic workflows to marketing operations is strongly valued.

  • Strong systems thinking and problem-solving skills, with a track record of taking ambiguous business problems, determining an appropriate technical solution, and independently driving work from solution design through implementation.

  • Strong attention to detail and collaborative communication skills, with experience establishing quality standards and partnering effectively across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Creative, and other cross-functional teams.

 

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility.

 

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $150,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training. In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

 

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is looking for an enthusiastic Senior Embedded Engineer to join our Software Organization as part of the Embedded Engineering team. You will work with Hardware, Signal Processing, Manufacturing and Product teams to develop and deliver against Hardware and Software roadmaps. The Embedded team’s mission is to build and deploy stable, accurate, and power efficient firmware platforms for all our in house developed devices via a seamless 24/7 connection and interaction between our mobile apps.

At Whoop, the Embedded team is at the intersection of the Hardware and Software domains, bridging the gap between the physical and the digital world. As a Senior Embedded Engineer you will collaborate with a diverse group of the industry’s best and brightest engineers in supporting current products, as well as developing new cutting edge products that help our members achieve their health and fitness goals with industry leading monitoring and data analysis.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and test firmware in C for WHOOP’s product line, including features optimized for low-power performance.

  • Take ownership of complex firmware features and ensure they meet performance, power, and reliability goals.

  • Debug and resolve challenging issues across software, hardware, manufacturing, and system integration.

  • Define, write, and maintain clear technical requirements and documentation.

  • Participate in code reviews to ensure clarity, correctness, and adherence to coding standards.

  • Design and improve firmware self-tests, validation tools, CI workflows, and internal development tools.

  • Support electrical development by evaluating components, bringing up drivers, and contributing to hardware design discussions.

  • Leverage AI as a development tool and share learnings with the team.

  • Collaborate with Electrical, Signal Processing, Mobile, and Manufacturing teams to validate designs and refine interfaces.

  • Mentor teammates by providing guidance on design, implementation, and debugging.

  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, power efficiency, stability, and reliability across the firmware platform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of embedded firmware development experience.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve ambiguous issues independently.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience mentoring and collaborating across teams.

  • Strong experience with electronics debugging tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and logic analyzers.

  • Proficient with device driver development and 32-bit RISC architectures such as ARM Cortex.

  • Proficient in C/C++ programming.

  • Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals, with proficiency in reading schematics and hardware specifications.

  • Experience working with operating systems (OS) and real-time operating systems (RTOS).

  • Strong understanding of system communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, USART/UART, and BLE.

  • Experience with version control using git and modern CI/CD workflows.

  • Experience with unit, integration, and functional testing for embedded systems.

  • Experience with Agile software development practices.

  • Experience working on high-volume consumer electronics products preferred.

  • Willingness to act as both a team player and a technical leader.

Learn more about our Software Org and how to be successful in your engineering career at WHOOP via our Career Framework. Also check out our AI studio blog here.

jobs.title: Staff Applied Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we’re on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our wearable technology collects rich physiological data, providing members with actionable insights into their recovery, training, and sleep.

We are seeking a Staff Applied Machine Learning Scientist to develop and continuously improve production-ready edge algorithms that transform sensor data into accurate, reliable, and real-time physiological insights. In this role, you will develop innovative approaches that combine deep learning, machine learning, and signal processing to deliver meaningful value to WHOOP members while optimizing for accuracy, latency, power, and scalability across wearable platforms.

You will work closely with a cross-functional team of scientists, engineers, physiologists, and hardware experts to solve challenging problems at the intersection of wearable sensing, physiological modeling, and applied AI. You will develop novel modeling approaches, and own complex algorithmic problems from early development through production deployment and continuous improvement.

Your work will directly shape the future of WHOOP’s sensing capabilities and our ability to provide members with accurate, personalized, and actionable insights into their health and performance.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design advanced algorithms that combine signal processing, physiological modeling, machine learning, and deep learning for physiological time-series and multimodal sensor data, with a focus on accuracy, robustness, and generalization across diverse members and real-world conditions.

  • Own the development and continuous improvement of production-ready edge algorithms that transform multimodal sensor data into accurate, reliable, and real-time physiological insights.

  • Analyze large-scale wearable sensor datasets to identify performance gaps, characterize challenging conditions, and drive data-informed algorithm improvements.

  • Define rigorous evaluation methodologies, validation frameworks, and performance metrics to assess algorithms throughout development and deployment.

  • Optimize algorithms for embedded deployment, balancing accuracy with power, memory, latency, and compute constraints across current and future wearable platforms.

  • Set technical direction and establish best practices for modeling, experimentation, validation, and algorithm development across complex sensing problems.

  • Pursue ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives from research and prototyping through validation, production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate closely with Data Science, Firmware, Software, Hardware, Product, and domain experts to translate algorithmic innovations into production-ready capabilities and member-facing features.

  • Stay at the forefront of advances in deep learning, machine learning, signal processing, edge AI, and physiological sensing, and translate relevant innovations into differentiated WHOOP capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

  • 7+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, deep learning, and/or signal processing algorithms for complex real-world applications.

  • Deep technical expertise in modern machine learning and deep learning methods, particularly for time-series and multimodal sensor data.

  • Strong foundation in digital and statistical signal processing, with the ability to combine classical signal processing techniques with modern learning-based approaches.

  • Strong proficiency in Python for algorithm development, experimentation, and large-scale data analysis; experience with C/C++ and embedded algorithm development is highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop robust models using large, noisy, real-world datasets and achieve strong generalization across diverse conditions.

  • Experience designing rigorous experiments, defining performance metrics, performing error analysis, and translating findings into algorithm improvements.

  • Experience taking algorithms through the full development lifecycle, from research and prototyping through validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and make sound technical decisions.

  • Experience with physiological signals, wearable sensors, or biomedical sensing is highly desirable.

  • Experience optimizing algorithms for resource-constrained embedded or edge environments, including tradeoffs across accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency, is a plus.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day work while maintaining high standards for quality and rigor.

Join us in pushing the boundaries of wearable sensing, applied AI, and physiological intelligence and positively impacting people’s lives!

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-Verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

WHOOP is hiring an FP&A Manager to serve as the finance business partner to our rapidly growing Wholesale organization. In this role, you will partner closely with Wholesale leadership to drive forecast accuracy, inform key commercial decisions, and improve the efficiency and profitability of the channel through disciplined financial planning, margin management, and analysis. You will bring together detailed financial modeling and strategic thinking to provide greater visibility into business performance while helping strengthen the finance infrastructure and processes that support the continued growth of Wholesale at WHOOP.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as the Finance business partner to the Wholesale organization, providing actionable financial and strategic insights to drive growth, efficiency, and profitability

  • Own and enhance financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and re-forecasting for Wholesale, including revenue, units, gross margin, and key operational drivers across retailers and products

  • Drive forecast accuracy and accountability by identifying key variances, risks, and opportunities and translating evolving business performance into an updated financial outlook

  • Own and optimize wholesale margin management and channel economics, maintaining visibility into retailer profitability and identifying opportunities to improve financial performance

  • Leverage and refine financial models and analytical frameworks to inform key commercial decisions, including new retailer partnerships, geographic expansion, pricing and promotions, and assortment strategy

  • Support the transition to an EPM system and continued maturation of core finance infrastructure, implementing process and reporting improvements that increase scalability, accuracy, and structure as the business grows

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or another highly analytical finance role

  • Strong financial modeling and forecasting skills, with demonstrated ability to translate business performance into forward-looking plans and actionable insights

  • Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin, and channel economics, including the impact of pricing, product mix, promotions, and other drivers of profitability

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; experience with EPM systems, SQL, Python, or other analytical tools is a plus

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to identify key business drivers, evaluate tradeoffs, and inform complex decisions

  • Highly effective, unbiased communicator with the ability to adapt communication style to different audiences. Can articulate complex data clearly to a diverse range of stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Development
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Corporate Development to help advance the inorganic growth strategy at WHOOP through M&A and strategic partnerships. This individual will work closely with senior executives and leaders across the company to identify and evaluate opportunities that accelerate the mission and long-term strategic priorities of WHOOP.

The ideal candidate will have proven skills in financial modeling, strategic assessment, and M&A due diligence, along with the curiosity and strategic thinking needed to identify important factors that may never fit on a spreadsheet. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between high-level strategy and detailed transaction execution, develop strong perspectives with imperfect information, and effectively collaborate with senior stakeholders across WHOOP and the broader technology, healthcare, and investment ecosystems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive Deal Execution: Lead key aspects of M&A, strategic investment, and partnership processes from initial evaluation through execution, including market mapping, target sourcing, financial analysis, valuation, due diligence, negotiation, approval materials, closing, and integration planning.

  • Partner with senior executives and Product leaders to translate strategic priorities into actionable market landscapes, target universes, and build/buy/partner recommendations.

  • Develop and maintain a prioritized pipeline of acquisition, investment, and strategic partnership opportunities, including proactive sourcing and outreach to prospective targets.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on financial analysis and valuation, including discounted cash flow analysis, precedent transactions, comparable companies, accretion/dilution analysis, unit economics, and business case modeling.

  • Build sophisticated long-term financial and capital models to assess potential transactions, new growth initiatives, and capital allocation decisions.

  • Lead cross-functional due diligence processes in partnership with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and other key stakeholders, synthesizing findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Develop rigorous quantitative and qualitative assessments of strategic growth initiatives, including new markets, technologies, products, and business lines, in close partnership with Corporate Strategy and other cross-functional teams.

  • Prepare clear, decision-oriented materials for senior executives and the Board, articulating investment theses, key risks, valuation considerations, strategic rationale, and potential impact on long-term value creation.

  • Play a lead role in transaction negotiations and structuring, developing perspectives on key economic and strategic terms and helping drive transactions toward successful outcomes.

  • Support post-transaction integration planning to ensure strategic objectives, operating priorities, and value-creation opportunities are clearly defined and executable.

  • Operate as a business athlete across WHOOP, serving as a flexible resource across the organization and applying financial analysis, strategic thinking, and project leadership to high-priority initiatives and complex business problems beyond the traditional scope of Corporate Development.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience across corporate development, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or related roles, with meaningful transaction experience.

  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and executing M&A transactions, strategic investments, or similarly complex strategic initiatives.

  • Deep expertise in financial modeling, valuation, unit economics, LTV modeling, and investment/business case development.

  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end M&A process, including sourcing, diligence, valuation, transaction structuring, negotiation, closing, and integration planning.

  • Experience managing complex, cross-functional workstreams and driving processes forward in fast-moving environments.

  • Strong strategic judgment and the ability to identify the most important qualitative and quantitative factors when evaluating opportunities with incomplete information.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to distill complex information into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the executive presence to effectively engage senior leaders, external executives, investors, advisors, and other stakeholders.

  • A track record of taking ownership, operating with a high degree of autonomy, and successfully driving negotiations and complex projects to completion.

  • A proactive, self-directed approach with the ability to identify what needs to be done, take initiative, and drive work forward with limited oversight, combined with a team-first, positive mindset and willingness to contribute wherever needed.

  • Experience in healthcare, consumer subscriptions, technology, or adjacent industries is preferred.

  • MBA preferred.

  • Unparalleled work ethic, intensity, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to grow and develop in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is looking for an enthusiastic Embedded Engineer II to join our Software Organization as part of the Embedded Engineering team. You will work with Hardware, Signal Processing, Manufacturing and Product teams to develop and deliver against Hardware and Software roadmaps. The Embedded team’s mission is to build and deploy stable, accurate, and power efficient firmware platforms for all our in house developed devices via a seamless 24/7 connection and interaction between our mobile apps.

At Whoop, the Embedded team is at the intersection of the Hardware and Software domains, bridging the gap between the physical and the digital world. As an Embedded Engineer II you will collaborate with a diverse group of the industry’s best and brightest engineers in supporting current products, as well as developing new cutting edge products that help our members achieve their health and fitness goals with industry leading monitoring and data analysis.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and test firmware in C for WHOOP’s product line, leveraging software tools, hardware tools, and instrumentation to aid in the development and debug process.

  • Contribute to firmware architecture design and feature development

  • Debug issues across software and hardware domains

  • Write and maintain clear technical documentation

  • Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with coding standards.

  • Support test automation by designing, implementing, and debugging firmware self-tests.

  • Support electrical development by contributing to component selection and bringing up drivers.

  • Leverage AI as a development tool and share learnings with teammates.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of embedded software development experience

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to use electronic test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and logic analyzers to aid in debug.

  • Proficient with device driver development

  • Proficient in C/C++ programming

  • Fluency in electrical engineering fundamentals and knowledge of electrical design basics

  • Familiarity with operating systems (OS) and real-time operating systems (RTOS).

  • Familiarity with system communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, and USART.

  • Familiarity with version control using git

  • Familiarity with unit and functional testing

jobs.title: Director of Battery Technology
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Director of Battery Technology to build and lead the Battery Technology organization, shaping the team and technical direction that will power current and future generations of WHOOP products. You will set the technical vision for battery technology and build a high-performing global team across the US and China to advance battery performance, safety, reliability, and integration.

As the leader of Battery Technology, you will own the multi-year roadmap for how WHOOP develops, validates, integrates, and manufactures battery technologies. You will partner across Hardware, Product, Operations, and Supply Chain to translate ambitious product goals into battery technology strategies, while developing relationships with cell manufacturers and technology partners that position WHOOP at the forefront of battery innovation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Build and lead the Battery Technology organization across Battery Cell Engineering, Battery Systems Engineering, and in-region engineering team members in China.

  • Define and drive the multi-year battery technology roadmap across cell chemistry, battery architecture, charging, safety, reliability, and performance.

  • Own battery technology development from advanced exploration and supplier development through design, validation, manufacturing ramp, and field performance.

  • Build strategic relationships with cell manufacturers and technology partners, influencing supplier roadmaps and identifying technologies that can differentiate future WHOOP products.

  • Partner across Hardware, Product, Operations, and Supply Chain to drive system-level decisions and tradeoffs across battery life, size, performance, integration, safety, cost, and member experience.

  • Develop technical leaders, engineering capabilities, processes, and infrastructure that enable the Battery Technology organization to execute and scale.

  • Travel up to 20% domestically and internationally to collaborate with partners, suppliers, and manufacturers.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of experience in battery technology, battery systems, electrochemistry, or related hardware engineering, including meaningful engineering leadership experience.

  • Deep expertise in lithium-ion cell technology, including chemistry, cell design, performance, degradation, safety, qualification, and manufacturing.

  • Strong understanding of battery systems, including pack architecture, charging, protection, validation, reliability, and product integration.

  • Demonstrated success developing battery technology roadmaps and bringing new technologies from exploration into high-volume products.

  • Experience building and leading multidisciplinary or geographically distributed engineering teams and developing technical leaders.

  • Proven ability to build strategic relationships with cell manufacturers and technology partners and influence supplier technology roadmaps.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity through complex technical and business tradeoffs.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

    The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $210,000 - $245,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

     

    In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package..

     

    These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Associate Director of Electrical Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring an Associate Director of Electrical Engineering to lead electrical engineering execution across New Product Introduction (NPI) and Continuous Improvement (CI) for a WHOOP hardware product line. You will lead a team of electrical engineers responsible for bringing new hardware from development through production and continuously improving products already in the field. As the electrical engineering leader for the product line, you will ensure strong technical execution, drive cross-functional alignment, and build a team that delivers reliable, high-quality hardware at scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, build, and develop the Electrical Engineering team responsible for NPI and Continuous Improvement across a WHOOP product line, establishing clear ownership, priorities, and accountability.

  • Own EE execution across the full product lifecycle, from early concept and requirements definition through design, validation, manufacturing ramp, sustaining, and continuous improvement.

  • Set technical direction and drive engineering excellence across electrical architecture, circuit design, component selection, design reviews, validation, and failure analysis.

  • Lead the EE team through key development milestones, proactively identifying technical and execution risks and ensuring issues are resolved with rigor and urgency.

  • Partner closely with Mechanical, Firmware, Systems, Battery, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product teams to drive system-level decisions and deliver against product requirements.

  • Build a high-performing EE organization by hiring and developing engineers, strengthening technical leadership, and ensuring the team has the capabilities and resources needed to deliver.

  • Establish and continuously improve EE processes, tools, documentation, and development practices that increase engineering quality, efficiency, and scalability across the product lifecycle.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of electrical engineering experience developing complex hardware products, with 4+ years experience leading engineers or technical teams.

  • Deep knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals, including circuit design, PCBAs, power architecture, component selection, design validation, and failure analysis.

  • Experience bringing high-volume hardware products through NPI, manufacturing ramp, and sustaining engineering.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience partnering with engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and external manufacturing partners.

  • Proven ability to develop engineers, establish clear technical direction, and create effective engineering processes in fast-moving environments.

  • Preferred: experience with consumer electronics, wearables, or similarly integrated and space-constrained hardware products.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a high level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.

As a Program Manager at WHOOP, you will be a critical member of the team that develops the next generation of models that will power the features we can provide to members. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, data science, sensor intelligence, platform engineering, and product, and is responsible for translating complex technical work into clear plans, dependencies, and outcomes to ensure projects are delivered on time, aligned to strategy, and built for scale.

Success in this role will require a high degree of adaptability and a solutions mindset, ability to simplify complexity, while continuously managing shifting priorities.

Foundation AI capabilities are critical to our ability to innovate quickly and responsibly. This role ensures that the underlying systems powering our features are delivered thoughtfully, reliably, and in a way that unlocks impact across the entire organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive Foundation AI projects from kickoff through development to deployment and stabilization

  • Support the VP of Foundation AI to translate strategy into executable roadmaps with clear milestones, risks, dependencies, and success metrics

  • Develop project plans consistent with business goals and requirements for algorithm performance

  • Establish and maintain program governance, including planning cadences, status reporting, decision forums, and executive communication

  • Work with the FAI team, Data Science, Sensor Intelligence, WHOOP Labs, Data Engineering, Software, Firmware to ensure project objectives and priorities are aligned across departments

  • Bring together key stakeholders to facilitate timely and lasting decision-making

  • Partner with the extended team on compute infrastructure planning, focusing on availability constraints, capacity forecasting, vendor quotes/lead times, and tradeoffs across vendors.

  • Partner with the broader RAD program management team to continuously improve the development process to enable execution of projects in an organized, methodical, and predictable manner.

  • Identify and manage project risks and issues, ensuring mitigations are in place to reduce potential impacts.

  • Facilitate cross-functional communication across WHOOP for awareness and understanding.

  • Understanding of technical issues to facilitate resolution of project blockers is a plus

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years of industry experience in program or project management, preferably involving AI/ML, data platforms or large-scale systems

  • Experience working with AI or applied ML teams

  • Familiarity with agile methodologies, sprint planning, backlog grooming processes

  • Data-driven approach to strategic planning, comfortable reviewing metrics and identifying ways to measure program success

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts (e.g., model training, inference, data pipelines, evaluation, experimentation), hands-on coding experience is not required

  • Clear, confident communicator who can bridge deeply technical teams and business stakeholders

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse teams

  • Nice to Have:

    • Experience working with research teams

    • Background in consumer technology, platforms, or data-driven products

    • Experience organizing projects using Jira or similar platforms

jobs.title: Marketplaces Lead - UK/EU

As WHOOP expands its global footprint, we are hiring a Marketplaces Lead to accelerate marketplace growth in the UK and EU. This individual will serve as a key regional marketing owner, responsible for executing digital campaigns, optimizing marketplace presence, and partnering cross-functionally to deliver performance across e-commerce platforms. You will play a vital role in ensuring WHOOP is positioned as the leading performance technology brand in the UK and EU.

This role is based in Ireland or the UK. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own regional marketing strategy and execution for key marketplaces across the UK and EU

  • Localize global campaigns, manage media budgets, and collaborate with the Brand team to ensure creative relevance, cultural resonance, and compliance with marketplace standards

  • Monitor customer reviews, ratings, and feedback to drive continuous improvement in brand perception and engagement

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid digital campaigns across search and display to achieve performance and efficiency goals

  • Serve as the primary liaison for marketplace partners, distributors, and agencies, ensuring brand consistency and flawless execution

  • Analyze marketing performance and marketplace trends, providing actionable insights to enhance conversion, engagement, and ROI

  • Evaluate and develop new marketplace opportunities in collaboration with Sales to expand WHOOP’s regional footprint

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5-8 years of experience in digital or performance marketing within Amazon, e-commerce, retail, or consumer marketing

  • Demonstrated success managing campaigns and product visibility across Amazon or comparable marketplaces

  • Experience operating in multi-country, cross-functional environments, ideally within the UK and EU

  • Strong project management and executional skills, with attention to detail and a data-driven mindset

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with comfort aligning regional and global priorities

  • Proficiency in using performance metrics to inform campaign optimization

  • Fluency in additional European languages

  • Passion for fitness, health, and technology

  • Willingness to travel regionally up to 15%

jobs.title: AVP, North America Sales
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

As WHOOP continues to scale, North America remains our largest and most strategically important commercial market. The AVP, Sales — North America will be responsible for accelerating growth, expanding distribution, strengthening strategic partnerships, and building the commercial organization required to take WHOOP to the next level.

The AVP, Sales — North America is responsible for leading the sales and distribution strategy for WHOOP across the United States and Canada.

This leader will own the North American commercial plan across retail, wholesale, strategic accounts, and other third-party channels, with a clear focus on driving profitable revenue growth and membership acquisition.

The role requires a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level: setting the commercial vision, developing executive relationships with our most important partners, negotiating major opportunities, and ensuring outstanding execution in stores and across channels.

The successful candidate will be a builder; someone who can scale a high-performing organization, create new growth engines, and continuously raise the standard for commercial execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

North America Commercial Strategy

  • Develop and execute the North America sales strategy and annual operating plan for WHOOP.

  • Own regional sales targets, forecasts, channel strategy, and commercial performance.

  • Identify and prioritize the largest opportunities to increase distribution, market share, and membership acquisition.

  • Balance near-term revenue delivery with long-term category development and brand building.

  • Partner with the WHOOP leadership team to shape the broader WHOOP commercial strategy.

Retail & Distribution

  • Lead the strategy to expand the WHOOP presence across national, regional, specialty, sporting goods, electronics, and other relevant retail channels.

  • Build a distribution network that makes WHOOP increasingly accessible to mainstream consumers while protecting its premium positioning.

  • Develop channel strategies that maximize productivity rather than simply maximizing doors.

  • Establish standards for merchandising, retail execution, product demonstration, inventory availability, and member acquisition.

  • Identify opportunities to create new retail experiences and points of presence.

  • Continuously evaluate distribution gaps relative to competitors.

Strategic Accounts

  • Build and maintain C-suite and senior executive relationships with the most important WHOOP retail and strategic partners.

  • Lead negotiations for major commercial agreements, launches, exclusives, promotions, and strategic partnerships.

  • Establish joint business plans with key accounts and hold partners accountable for agreed growth objectives.

  • Develop relationships that go beyond transactional selling to create long-term strategic value for both WHOOP and its partners.

  • Represent WHOOP externally with major customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.

Sales Performance & Commercial Excellence

  • Deliver the North American sales target.

  • Be accountable for sell-in, sell-through, inventory productivity, revenue, and membership acquisition.

  • Establish rigorous sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance-management processes.

  • Develop channel-level economics and ensure commercial decisions are grounded in contribution margin and lifetime value.

  • Establish clear targets and KPIs for the sales organization and individual account teams.

  • Identify and address performance gaps quickly.

  • Build a culture of data-driven decision making and operational excellence.

Go-to-Market & Launch Excellence

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to deliver major product and membership launches.

  • Develop channel-specific launch strategies that maximize awareness, distribution, availability, and conversion.

  • Ensure sales organizations and retail partners are fully prepared for launches.

  • Establish best practices for retail training, merchandising, demos, sampling, and consumer education.

  • Ensure WHOOP maintains a consistent and premium brand experience across all channels.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing North American sales organization.

  • Define the appropriate organizational structure across key accounts, retail, channel development, sales operations, and strategic partnerships.

  • Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional commercial talent.

  • Establish a culture of high standards, accountability, urgency, and collaboration.

  • Ensure the organization remains highly connected to global WHOOP commercial and functional teams.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Product, Membership, and Customer Experience.

  • Create a single North American commercial plan across functions.

  • Ensure sales priorities are aligned with company-wide strategic objectives.

  • Bring market, consumer, competitive, and retailer insights into global decision-making.

  • Act as the voice of the North American customer and retail ecosystem within WHOOP.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • 15+ years of experience in sales, commercial leadership, or general management within consumer technology, consumer electronics, wearables, fitness, health technology, or another relevant premium consumer category.

  • 8+ years leading large-scale sales or commercial organizations.

  • Proven track record of delivering significant revenue growth in North America.

  • Deep experience with national retail, specialty retail, wholesale, and/or omnichannel businesses.

  • Demonstrated success negotiating and managing relationships with major US retailers.

  • Strong understanding of both physical retail and e-commerce.

  • Experience building and scaling high-performing sales organizations.

  • Strong financial acumen and experience managing forecasts, budgets, and commercial economics.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively with C-suite executives, both internally and externally.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

  • Willingness to travel regularly.

Preferred

  • Experience scaling a premium consumer technology or connected-device brand.

  • Experience with subscription, membership, or recurring revenue businesses.

  • Experience taking a consumer technology product from enthusiast adoption toward mainstream adoption.

  • Experience working across both DTC and third-party channels.

  • Passion for health, fitness, human performance, and technology.

  • Experience in a high-growth, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $180,000 - $245,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Android Engineer II (AI Momentum)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our technology delivers personalized insights across sleep, strain, recovery, and health to help members better understand their physiology and make informed decisions every day.

WHOOP is seeking an Android Engineer II to help build and evolve the mobile experiences that bring WHOOP data and insights to our members. You will work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineering teams to develop high-quality Android features, shape technical architecture, and improve the performance and reliability of the WHOOP app. You will have meaningful ownership across the development lifecycle, from defining technical solutions through testing, release, and ongoing optimization.

The AI Momentum team is responsible for delivering personalized recommendations to WHOOP members. As an Android Engineer II, you will develop native Android and AI features that power WHOOP's recommendation engine to drive behavior change and positive health outcomes for our members.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain high-quality Android product experiences using Kotlin and modern Android development practices

  • Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineers to develop scalable solutions and define effective APIs and data contracts across the WHOOP platform

  • Contribute to Android architecture and technical decision-making, including modular design, application performance, maintainability, and documentation

  • Monitor application performance, crash data, member feedback, and product metrics to identify issues and continuously improve reliability and the member experience

  • Contribute to the Android release lifecycle, including builds, build variants, signing, testing and distribution through Firebase, and releases through the Google Play Store

  • Support the growth of the engineering team through thoughtful code reviews, knowledge sharing, technical documentation, and onboarding of fellow engineers

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building, testing, debugging, and delivering native Android applications in a professional environment

  • Proficiency with Kotlin and familiarity with modern Android technologies such as Coroutines, Jetpack libraries, ViewModel, Flow, Navigation, Room, Retrofit, and OkHttp

  • Strong understanding of Android application architecture, lifecycle, components, and platform design principles

  • Experience designing mobile applications using scalable architectural and modular design patterns such as MVVM

  • Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and collaborating with backend engineers on data contracts

  • Product-oriented mindset with empathy for the member experience and an interest in using data and feedback to improve products

  • Ability to collaborate effectively, communicate technical concepts clearly, and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Staff Electrical Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Staff Electrical Engineer to play a critical technical leadership role in the development of our next-generation wearable platform. As part of the Hardware Engineering team, you will develop a deep understanding of electrical system behavior through rigorous test, characterization, analysis, and hands-on debugging, then translate those insights into architecture, schematic, and design improvements. You will work across Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Systems, Manufacturing, and Software teams to identify performance limitations, resolve complex system-level issues, and accelerate the path toward robust, production-ready hardware.

This is a hands-on player-coach role for an engineer who combines deep electrical expertise with exceptional systems thinking and technical judgment. You will manage and develop a small team of electrical engineers while remaining deeply engaged at the bench—defining the highest-value technical questions, designing experiments to answer them, interpreting complex data, and driving the resulting design decisions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead electrical system characterization and technical investigations, developing a deep understanding of system behavior across power, mixed-signal circuitry, digital interfaces, sensing, noise, timing, and other critical performance areas

  • Define and execute experiments that efficiently answer complex engineering questions, isolate variables, identify root causes, and expose interactions across electrical subsystems and the broader product

  • Translate characterization results and system insights into actionable architecture, schematic, component, layout, firmware, and system-level design improvements

  • Drive resolution of complex electrical and cross-functional technical issues, using first-principles analysis, bench measurements, device telemetry, and structured experimentation to move from symptoms to root cause

  • Build scalable characterization and analysis methods using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent tools to improve test coverage, automate analysis, identify trends, and accelerate engineering learning cycles

  • Partner closely with Electrical, Firmware, Mechanical, Systems, Software, and Manufacturing teams to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and improve end-to-end system performance, reliability, and manufacturability

  • Manage and develop a small team of electrical engineers, setting technical priorities, creating clear ownership, providing mentorship and design review, and helping engineers grow while maintaining a high bar for technical execution

  • Remain hands-on with schematic and circuit design, prototype bring-up, debugging, and design iteration, directly contributing to critical design changes where needed

  • Establish rigorous validation approaches and success criteria that build confidence in electrical system performance across operating conditions, unit-to-unit variation, and product use cases

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally to collaborate with partners, suppliers, and contract manufacturers

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 8+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership and ownership of complex electrical or embedded systems

  • Deep electrical engineering fundamentals across mixed-signal circuit design, power management, digital interfaces, signal integrity, and debugging of highly integrated systems

  • Exceptional hands-on test, characterization, and debugging skills, with the ability to use experimentation and data to understand complex system behavior and drive meaningful design changes

  • Strong experience with schematic capture and PCB design/review using ECAD tools such as Altium or equivalent

  • Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional technical investigations, mentor other engineers, and drive complex engineering decisions to closure

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

 

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $175,000 - $215,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

 

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer (Manufacturing)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Hardware Test Engineer (Manufacturing) to develop the automated test solutions that ensure every WHOOP device meets the highest standards of quality and reliability. You will drive manufacturing test strategy from early product development through mass production, developing test methodologies, electrical test systems, and automated test software that are deployed on manufacturing lines around the world. Working closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, and the Manufacturing Platform Software team, you'll build scalable production test solutions that enable rapid product launches and world-class manufacturing quality.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and implement manufacturing test solutions for products and subsystems, contributing to Design for Test (DFT) efforts throughout the product development lifecycle

  • Develop and validate test methodologies to achieve appropriate coverage, accuracy, repeatability, and robustness for production use

  • Design, build, and validate automated test equipment (ATE), electrical test systems, instrumentation, and control systems, and partner on the development of production test fixtures

  • Develop automated test software in Python to control instrumentation and validate electrical, functional, RF, and sensor performance in manufacturing

  • Collaborate with Hardware, Firmware, Manufacturing, Quality, and Mechanical Engineering teams to implement test requirements, improve test coverage, reduce cycle time, and increase manufacturing yield

  • Support factory bring-up and production activities with manufacturing partners, including fixture qualification, calibration, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of deployed test systems

  • Analyze manufacturing and test data using statistical methods to identify failure trends, evaluate test performance, and support improvements to product quality and manufacturing processes

  • Own test development projects and execute defined workstreams within larger product development programs, working with senior engineers to resolve complex technical challenges

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • 2+ years of experience developing hardware test systems, automated test equipment, or manufacturing test solutions for consumer electronics or similar products

  • Strong fundamentals in electronics and experience working with laboratory instrumentation and communication protocols such as UART, I²C, SPI, USB, Bluetooth, or NFC

  • Understanding of metrology fundamentals, including measurement accuracy, repeatability, and calibration

  • Experience designing, building, or debugging electrical test systems, including schematics, test interface electronics, or PCBAs; experience with tools such as Altium Designer is a plus

  • Proficiency in Python and experience using software to automate hardware, instrumentation, or test processes; experience with C/C++ or other systems languages is a plus

  • Experience debugging hardware and software issues using structured problem-solving techniques

  • Experience analyzing engineering or manufacturing data to evaluate test performance and identify failure trends; familiarity with SPC and manufacturing process capability is a plus

  • Experience working in a manufacturing or production environment is preferred

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Ability to travel up to 15%, both domestically and internationally

  • Strong commitment to leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions
