jobs.title: Researcher II, Weekend Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we’re on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies, behaviors, and daily lives.

WHOOP Labs is the on-site research facility for product development and innovation at WHOOP. We conduct human-centered hardware and algorithm research to create best-in-class product experiences that work for all members.

WHOOP is hiring a Researcher II to support research planning and execution on weekends, supporting critical data collection windows for participant diversity and expanded access. This role will cover a broad range of research studies for algorithm training, hardware validation, and design testing. While your home base will be WHOOP’s on-site product research facility, WHOOP Labs, studies will include field collections across the metro Boston area to widen access for diverse communities. Your efforts will support the organization as we continue to develop a best-in-class experience and lead the wearables industry.

*This role is fully onsite at our Boston, MA office and follows a 4x10 schedule, with four 10-hour workdays each week, Friday through Monday, and three days off Tuesday through Thursday.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute testing protocols across multiple concurrent studies, owning research execution on weekends and collaborating with other researchers on Friday and Monday to ensure consistent protocol administration across all days and shifts.

  • Own research documentation for weekend hours, collaborating with other researchers on Friday and Monday to ensure effective handoffs and information transfer across shifts.

  • Provide coaching and guidance to participants during exercise protocols, balancing data integrity, research best practices, and participant experience

  • Create a supportive and welcoming environment for participants engaging in a range of research tasks, from exercises to device interactions

  • Manage the use, troubleshooting, and upkeep of sensitive data collection equipment and prototype devices

  • Develop strong working knowledge of WHOOP’s research platform tooling suite, with the ability to troubleshoot issues in real time—including during active data collections—and problem-solve on the fly

  • Develop junior researchers by providing technical coaching, delegation, constructive feedback, and growth opportunities

  • Own daily lab management tasks required for data collections to be successful, such as laundry, equipment cleaning, material organization, and overall lab readiness

  • Serve as an ambassador for WHOOP Labs and the WHOOP brand

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in human physiology, biomedical engineering, psychology, HCI, or similar

  • Professional experience in research & development, human subjects research, or a related field, including 2+ years of experience conducting human subjects research

  • Strong technological background and working knowledge of data management systems including the Google Suite

  • Familiarity with research platform tools and hardware testing environments preferred

  • Strong interpersonal communication skills with a savvy for working as part of a highly collaborative, fast-paced team

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in dynamic research settings

  • Prior experience in customer service or other public-facing roles a plus

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with confidence giving and receiving feedback across disciplines

jobs.title: Senior Edge Algorithm Integration Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring an Edge Algorithm Integration Engineer to join the Edge ML team and bring Sensor Intelligence algorithms from validated reference implementations to production execution on WHOOP devices. You will own the technical path from reference algorithm to edge deployment, translating and optimizing algorithms for embedded hardware, resolving cross-platform dependencies, integrating with firmware and sensor infrastructure, and ensuring implementations preserve expected algorithm performance. You will work across Sensor Intelligence, Firmware, Edge ML Platform, Mobile, Cloud, and Connectivity teams to enable algorithms to run reliably and efficiently within the compute, memory, latency, and power constraints of WHOOP devices.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the end-to-end technical path for porting developed and validated Sensor Intelligence algorithms from reference environments to production-ready implementations on WHOOP embedded platforms.

  • Translate Python, MATLAB, and other reference implementations into efficient, production-quality C/C++, optimizing signal-processing and machine-learning algorithms for compute, memory, latency, power, and real-time execution.

  • Understand algorithm architecture, data flow, runtime requirements, and dependencies across cloud, mobile, connectivity, sensor pipelines, libraries, and platform services; drive the technical work required to resolve or redesign dependencies for on-device execution.

  • Integrate algorithms with firmware, sensor pipelines, embedded services, and Edge ML platform capabilities, partnering closely with Sensor Intelligence and Firmware teams to define interfaces, requirements, acceptance criteria, and system-level behavior.

  • Establish functional and numerical equivalence between reference and edge implementations, profile on-device performance, and debug complex issues spanning algorithms, sensors, firmware, and embedded systems.

  • Build reusable tools, test harnesses, profiling infrastructure, and deployment patterns that accelerate future algorithm migrations and enable efficient portability across current and next-generation WHOOP hardware platforms.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Algorithm Validation Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we’re on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.


WHOOP is seeking an Senior Algorithm Validation Scientist to join the Sensor Intelligence organization and help ensure our physiological sensing algorithms deliver accurate, equitable, and scientifically validated performance for our members. In this role, you will design rigorous statistical analyses and validation studies that evaluate algorithm performance throughout development and after deployment, translating complex real-world data into evidence that informs algorithm quality and product decisions. You’ll partner closely with scientists, engineers, and product teams to understand algorithm behavior, quantify uncertainty, identify opportunities for improvement, and help ensure members receive accurate and trustworthy insights.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and execute rigorous statistical analyses and validation studies to evaluate the accuracy, precision, reliability, robustness, and generalizability of physiological sensing algorithms against reference-standard measurements

  • Develop equivalence and non-inferiority analyses for hardware revisions, manufacturing changes, algorithm updates, and other changes that may affect the member experience, defining appropriate performance metrics, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and uncertainty estimates

  • Evaluate algorithm performance across demographic groups, physiological characteristics, environmental conditions, and behavioral contexts to identify performance differences, edge cases, and opportunities to improve algorithm quality and equity

  • Analyze experimental and observational production data to understand real-world algorithm behavior and draw defensible conclusions, applying approaches such as within-subject designs, difference-in-differences, matching, and other methods to account for confounding factors

  • Develop reproducible analysis workflows and automated validation processes that enable analyses to be consistently repeated across new cohorts, hardware revisions, and algorithm releases

  • Partner with Algorithm Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Product Managers, Clinical Scientists, and Software Engineers to design validation protocols, establish statistical best practices, communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences, and translate evidence into product improvements


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Epidemiology, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years of experience applying statistical methods to complex experimental or observational datasets, ideally within healthcare, medical devices, wearables, digital health, consumer technology, or a related field

  • Strong foundation in statistical inference, hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, uncertainty quantification, and validation study design; experience with equivalence, non-inferiority, causal inference, method-comparison, or related approaches is a plus

  • Proficiency analyzing large datasets using Python, R, or similar statistical programming tools, along with SQL and experience working with large-scale data environments

  • Experience with physiological, wearable, biomedical sensor, time-series, or longitudinal data; experience evaluating machine learning or signal processing algorithms is a plus

  • Familiarity with advanced statistical methodologies such as mixed-effects models, Bayesian statistics, survival analysis, fairness and parity analysis, or related approaches

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical findings into clear conclusions and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Senior Global Supply Manager - Contract Manufacturing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our hardware, software, and analytics work together to provide members with actionable insights that help them improve their health and performance.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Global Supply Manager, Contract Manufacturing to lead the commercial strategy and management of key global manufacturing partners across new product introduction, production ramp, mass production, and sustaining programs. In this role, you will own complex commercial negotiations, manufacturing cost strategy, supplier governance, capacity and investment decisions, and contractual workstreams that enable WHOOP to deliver innovative products at scale.

You will operate at the intersection of Global Supply Management, Manufacturing, Hardware Engineering, Quality, Finance, Legal, Materials, Operations, and Program Management. As a senior commercial leader, you will independently navigate complex supplier relationships, translate technical and operational requirements into effective commercial frameworks, and drive decisions that improve cost competitiveness, supply resilience, speed, and the WHOOP member experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the commercial strategy and key business relationships with assigned contract manufacturing partners across product development, NPI, production ramp, mass production, and sustaining operations.

  • Lead complex negotiations covering manufacturing value-add, labor and overhead, supplier margin, NRE, tooling, capital equipment, capacity, payment terms, inventory exposure, productivity commitments, and other components of total manufacturing cost.

  • Build, evaluate, and challenge detailed manufacturing cost models and supplier quotations, partnering with Finance, Manufacturing, and Global Supply Management teams to improve cost transparency, validate assumptions, and drive lifecycle cost and productivity improvements.

  • Drive commercial readiness for new and existing products, including RFQs, supplier proposals, capacity and capital plans, contractual commitments, and manufacturing-partner sourcing or allocation decisions.

  • Establish strong supplier governance and executive relationships, using business reviews, performance metrics, and corrective-action plans to drive accountability across cost, quality, delivery, capacity, productivity, inventory, and commercial execution.

  • Lead resolution of complex supplier and commercial issues while identifying longer-term opportunities to strengthen manufacturing strategy, supplier economics, operating mechanisms, and supply-chain resilience.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in global supply management, strategic sourcing, contract manufacturing, supplier commercial management, or a related function within consumer electronics, consumer hardware, or another high-volume manufacturing environment.

  • Demonstrated experience owning complex commercial relationships with contract manufacturers, ODMs, or JDMs and supporting products through development, NPI, production ramp, and mass production.

  • Strong understanding of contract manufacturing economics, including manufacturing value-add, labor and overhead, yield and utilization, supplier margin, NRE, tooling, capital equipment, material markups, inventory liability, and payment terms.

  • Proven experience leading complex commercial negotiations, developing or challenging detailed cost models, and translating technical and operational requirements into effective financial and contractual structures.

  • Ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and independently drive complex commercial issues to resolution in a fast-paced, global environment.

  • Ability to travel internationally approximately 25% of the time to support negotiations, business reviews, manufacturing readiness, supplier relationships, and critical program milestones.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibilityThe WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $195,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training. In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package. These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

WHOOP is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer II with a focus on New Product Introduction (NPI) to help bring innovative hardware products from prototype development through production ramp. In this role, you will partner closely with Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain, and our manufacturing partners to develop, validate, and optimize manufacturing processes that deliver high-quality products efficiently and at scale. You will combine strong technical fundamentals with a hands-on approach to solving manufacturing challenges, improving processes, and ensuring manufacturing readiness throughout the product development lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive manufacturing technical readiness for new product introductions through process development and optimization, manufacturing documentation, process validation, and fixture qualification

  • Partner with factory teams and cross-functional engineering partners to design, develop, and qualify manufacturing fixtures, equipment, and processes, using data-driven approaches to identify opportunities for effective automation

  • Develop and validate manufacturing processes that meet product specifications, establishing appropriate process controls to ensure consistent quality, efficiency, and reliability

  • Apply DFX and Lean Six Sigma principles to improve product manufacturability, quality, cycle time, efficiency, and cost throughout development and production

  • Lead structured problem-solving efforts, including DOEs, failure analysis, DMAIC, and 8D methodologies, to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement effective corrective actions

  • Drive cross-functional execution through rapid development and production ramp cycles, clearly communicating manufacturing risks, development progress, issue resolution, and project status to internal and external partners

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

  • 3+ years of manufacturing engineering or related experience supporting moderate- to high-volume production environments

  • Hands-on experience developing, qualifying, and troubleshooting manufacturing processes on the factory floor

  • Experience with manufacturing processes for small electronic products, such as adhesives, heat staking, automated assembly, or manual assembly

  • Working knowledge of injection-molded plastic part principles, common defect modes, process qualification, and GD&T principles

  • Experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks and applying sound engineering principles to fixture or manufacturing equipment design

  • Strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines and with external manufacturing partners in CM/JDM environments; willingness to travel up to 25% as needed

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

jobs.title: Senior Research Manager, Weekend Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we’re on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies, behaviors, and daily lives.

WHOOP Labs is the on-site research facility for product development and innovation at WHOOP. We conduct human-centered hardware and algorithm research to create best-in-class product experiences that work for all members.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Research Manager to lead research efforts on weekends, supporting critical data collection windows for participant diversity and expanded access. This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the operation of WHOOP Labs Boston during weekend hours, and will help shape weekend research and community fieldwork strategy. As a strategic partner, program leader, and people manager, you will build deep relationships across the research leadership team, drive operational excellence during weekend hours, and develop a high-performing team delivering rigorous, high-impact research.

*This role is fully onsite at our Boston, MA office and follows a 4x10 schedule, with four 10-hour workdays each week, Friday through Monday, and three days off Tuesday through Thursday.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with the rest of the Human Subjects Research leadership team to build a research roadmap, understand study priorities, and ensure high quality data collection across team shifts.

  • Collaborate with the Community Engagement Lead and wider Lab Operations team to support on- and off-site community engagement initiatives, helping to diversify participants in the WHOOP Labs research panel.

  • Own operational oversight of weekend WHOOP Labs Boston operation including participant experience, research session execution, and documentation for handoffs.

  • Provide feedback on “off hours” operations, contributing to team retros, participant compliance meetings, and other forums for senior leadership insight.

  • Serve as a senior individual contributor on complex research initiatives while championing participant experience and best practices in human subjects research.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of researchers and coordinators, fostering strong research craft, operational discipline, cross-functional collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I (Frontend, AI Platform)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.


As a Software Engineer I (Frontend), you will help build the user experiences that power WHOOP’s digital products. With direction from senior engineers, you will ship high-quality code for member-facing features to production, using modern web technologies and AI-assisted development workflows to prototype and iterate rapidly. This role is ideal for an early-career engineer who cares about user experience, learns quickly from feedback, and wants to grow toward owning features from concept through launch.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build well-defined parts of member-facing features from designs and requirements, estimate your work, and see your part through to production

  • Prototype, iterate on, and ship features using AI-assisted development workflows, with guidance and code review from your teammates

  • Contribute to high-quality, performant web applications built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS

  • Implement responsive, mobile-first user interfaces from designs so they work well across devices

  • Test your code against core user journeys, take part in code reviews, and apply the feedback you receive to each new contribution

  • Work closely with product, design, and backend teams, asking questions to understand the reasoning behind product and UX decisions

  • Learn and apply the team’s best practices in frontend architecture, performance, accessibility, and maintainability

  • Grow your knowledge of the systems your team owns and take part in the on-call rotation, escalating issues when needed

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 0 to 2 years of professional experience in frontend or full stack software development, including internships or co-ops

  • Solid fundamentals in JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS

  • Experience building web applications with React through work, internships, coursework, or personal projects (Next.js and Tailwind CSS experience is a plus)

  • Experience shipping user-facing work, such as a product feature, an internship project, or a personal app

  • Care for user experience and attention to detail, with curiosity about how members use the product

  • Familiarity with building responsive, mobile-first interfaces

  • Eagerness to work and learn in a fast-paced, iterative environment with an emphasis on rapid prototyping and continuous improvement

  • Familiarity with integrating frontend code with RESTful APIs, and interest in learning to work across the stack

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the habit of researching a problem on your own before asking for help and bringing the options you have considered when you do

  • Clear communication and collaboration skills, including comfort asking questions and sharing progress often

jobs.title: Senior Sensor Intelligence Engineer (Embedded Algorithms)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. By combining advanced sensing, data science, and technology designed for continuous wear, WHOOP delivers insights that help members better understand and improve their health and performance.

WHOOP is looking for a Senior Sensor Intelligence Engineer to join our Embedded Controls team within Sensor Intelligence and help shape the sensing capabilities across current and future WHOOP devices. Sitting at the intersection of signal processing, machine learning, embedded systems, and sensor technology, you will develop algorithms that interpret real-world sensor signals and intelligently control how sensors operate on-device. You will work across the sensing stack from understanding sensor physics and signal characteristics through algorithm development and embedded deployment to enable increasingly sophisticated sensing capabilities while meeting the power, compute, memory, and reliability constraints of a continuously worn device.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop signal-processing and machine-learning algorithms that interpret physiological, motion, and other wearable sensor signals, including applications such as activity and state detection, wear detection, signal-quality assessment, and device-state estimation

  • Design intelligent embedded control strategies that dynamically configure sensor behavior based on signal quality, device state, user context, system requirements, and power constraints

  • Characterize new and existing sensors by understanding signal behavior, noise sources, artifacts, dynamic range, sampling requirements, calibration, operating modes, and the impact of analog and acquisition architectures

  • Prototype algorithms and sensing strategies using tools such as Python or MATLAB, then partner with Firmware Engineering to translate them into robust, computationally efficient implementations suitable for resource-constrained embedded systems

  • Partner closely with Firmware, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Hardware, and broader Sensor Intelligence teams to bring up new sensing modalities, debug issues across the sensing stack, and inform sensing architectures for future WHOOP products

  • Develop experiments, analysis frameworks, and validation methodologies to evaluate sensor and algorithm performance across users and real-world conditions, optimizing solutions for accuracy, robustness, latency, memory, compute, and power

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Physics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong foundation in digital signal processing and time-series analysis, with experience applying techniques such as filtering, spectral analysis, sampling theory, noise reduction, and feature extraction to real-world sensor data

  • Experience developing signal-processing and/or machine-learning algorithms for noisy, artifact-prone sensor data and taking algorithms beyond offline analysis toward real-time, embedded, or production implementation

  • Strong proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or similar algorithm-development environments, with working knowledge of C/C++ and embedded-system considerations such as timing, memory, compute, and hardware interfaces

  • Working knowledge of sensor and electrical systems, including concepts such as ADCs, analog front ends, sampling, digital interfaces, noise, calibration, and signal acquisition

  • Ability to investigate and solve ambiguous engineering problems across algorithm, firmware, sensor, and electrical boundaries using strong experimental and analytical methods

  • Experience with wearable, physiological, optical, impedance, motion, multimodal, or related sensor systems is valued; experience with embedded inference, sensor fusion, fixed-point processing, quantization, low-power sensing, or microcontroller deployment is a plus

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. jobs.title: Director of Embedded Software Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level and live longer through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Director of Embedded Software Engineering to lead our Firmware organization and the embedded software at the core of every WHOOP device. This leader will set the technical and organizational direction for Firmware, develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, and ensure the organization delivers reliably across an ambitious roadmap of new products, platform investments, and continuous improvements to products already in the field.

Firmware sits at the intersection of WHOOP’s hardware, sensing, algorithms, mobile software, manufacturing, and member experience. This role will lead multiple teams responsible for building stable, accurate, and power-efficient firmware platforms that operate continuously in highly constrained wearable devices. You will translate business and product priorities into clear technical strategies, build an organization capable of executing at scale, and strengthen the processes and platforms through which WHOOP develops and delivers firmware.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and scale multiple Firmware teams with clear ownership and accountability, hiring and developing engineering managers, technical leaders, and senior individual contributors.

jobs.title: Rework Technician II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Rework Technician II to support the development, testing, and refinement of innovative wearable technology. In this hands-on role, you will partner closely with mechanical, electrical, and firmware engineers to build prototypes, perform electrical and mechanical rework, conduct testing and failure analysis, and help maintain highly organized engineering lab environments. The ideal candidate brings strong technical aptitude across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to execute high-quality work in a fast-paced product development environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform electrical rework, soldering, troubleshooting, and analysis of PCBAs and other electronic components, including fine-pitch and small-form-factor components

  • Build and assemble prototypes, cable assemblies, test fixtures, and small-scale manufacturing assemblies in partnership with electrical and mechanical engineering teams

  • Conduct electrical and mechanical product testing, dimensional measurements, and inspections using tools such as microscopes, vision measurement systems, and calipers

  • Support failure analysis of engineering prototypes and consumer returns, documenting findings and communicating results to engineering partners

  • Maintain and organize electrical, mechanical, and automated test labs, including managing parts inventory, equipment, 3D printers, and lab supplies

  • Support engineering development activities including firmware updates, prototype modifications, test circuit board builds, and other hands-on technical work as needed

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of relevant technician, electronics rework, prototyping, manufacturing, engineering lab, or related hands-on experience

  • Demonstrated experience with PCBA rework and soldering, including working with fine-pitch components; experience with BGA and 0201 or smaller components is a plus

  • Hands-on mechanical aptitude with experience in areas such as prototype assembly, product testing, cable or wire harness assembly, adhesives, fixtures, or 3D printing

  • Experience using measurement, inspection, and troubleshooting equipment such as microscopes, calipers, vision measurement systems, multimeters, or similar tools

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage equipment, components, documentation, and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Associate degree in an engineering, science, or technical field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant hands-on experience

  • Interest in consumer electronics, wearable technology, health, fitness, or performance products

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibilityThe WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $110,000 - $150,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training. In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package. These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Business Analyst I, Healthcare Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. The WHOOP membership includes a wearable device, advanced analytics, a personalized coaching platform, and a community of high performers worldwide.

About the Role

We are seeking a Business Analyst I to join our Healthcare Product Analytics team to deliver high-quality analysis and insights that support WHOOP's Health Operating System — our growing suite of clinical features, personalized wellness experiences, and health outcome measurement tools.

This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is energized by health and wellness and motivated by member impact. You are curious and confident exploring data, and eager to tackle complex analytical questions in partnership with product teams building features that help members manage their health. By transforming data into actionable insight, you will help ensure our healthcare experiences meaningfully enhance the WHOOP member journey.

Responsibilities

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Digital Health, Software Engineering, UX & Design, Data Science, and Marketing teams to support analysis that informs healthcare product strategy and roadmap decisions.

  • Healthcare Product Performance & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting to track key healthcare product metrics such as feature engagement, adoption of recommended behaviors, member-reported outcomes, and program completion.

  • Insights & Analysis: Conduct structured analyses to understand how healthcare features influence member behavior, health engagement, and wellness outcomes, summarizing findings with clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Experimentation Support: Assist in the design, measurement, and analysis of A/B tests evaluating healthcare product features, ensuring proper metric definitions and result interpretation with guidance.

  • Data Quality & Validation: Write clean SQL queries, validate data accuracy across systems, and partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure reliable tracking and instrumentation for healthcare features.

  • Trend Monitoring & Escalation: Monitor healthcare product KPIs, proactively identify meaningful trends or anomalies, and escalate findings or recommend follow-up analyses in partnership with senior team members.

  • Member Segment Understanding: Support analyses that uncover insights about key member segments — including those managing hormonal health, cardiometabolic health, or seeking more personalized wellness support.

  • Documentation & Process: Contribute to repeatable tools and processes for analytics across health features — from data documentation to dashboards and weekly health performance reviews.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in a Business Analyst or similar analytical role, preferably in a product-focused environment.

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Business, Economics, Data Science, Public Health, or a related field.

  • Working knowledge of SQL with the ability to write clean, well-structured queries (or strong interest in developing SQL proficiency).

  • Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Sigma, Amplitude, Looker, Hex, or similar.

  • Foundational understanding of A/B testing and experimentation principles.

  • Strong analytical curiosity with the ability to break down problems using data.

  • Clear communication skills with the ability to summarize findings in an answer-first format.

  • Collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced, evolving healthcare product environment.

  • Interest in health, wellness, and how data-driven features shape member health outcomes.

  • Commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, holding AI-assisted work to the same quality bar as personal contributions.

Bonus

  • Familiarity with modern data stacks: Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows.

  • Background or coursework in health sciences, public health, biostatistics, or a related field.

  • Exposure to product analytics — feature adoption, funnel analysis, cohort comparisons.

  • Experience working with sensitive data (HIPAA, PII) or in a healthcare-adjacent environment.

  • Interest in how algorithms and clinical science translate into consumer health products.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

 

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

 

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 -$110,0000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Social Media Coordinator to help power a distinctive, culturally relevant social presence as we continue to scale globally. In this role, you will own the systems and workflows that keep the Social team moving—from managing the content calendar and publishing across channels to coordinating content through production, approvals, and launch. You’ll bring strong organization, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of social platforms to help the team operate efficiently while contributing ideas that strengthen how WHOOP shows up across social.

This role reports to the Senior Manager, Social Content.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own and maintain the social content calendar, establishing publishing timelines and ensuring briefs, assets, copy, owners, approvals, and launch dates are organized and visible in one place.

  • Lead day-to-day publishing across WHOOP social channels, scheduling and posting content with the appropriate copy, tags, links, formatting, and platform-specific requirements.

  • Coordinate content workflows from brief through production, review, approval, and publishing, maintaining clear statuses and proactively identifying risks to deadlines.

  • Lead social calendar checkpoints and collaborate with internal partners to ensure upcoming content has clear ownership, next steps, and the information needed to launch on time.

  • Maintain publishing, project management, and analytics systems, ensuring content is accurately tagged and performance data is organized and reliable for ongoing reporting.

  • Contribute to brainstorms, monitor emerging platform features and social trends, and support recurring performance reporting by identifying clear takeaways that can inform future content.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1+ years of experience managing social accounts for a brand, creator, or media company including relevant internship or equivalent experience.

  • Strong, platform-native understanding of major social platforms, audience behavior, publishing best practices, content algorithms, and emerging trends.

  • Experience using social media management tools such as Sprinklr or similar platforms, as well as project management tools such as monday.com, Notion, or similar.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workflows, publishing schedules, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating cross-functionally across creative, marketing, communications, production, or related teams and proactively surfacing potential blockers.

  • Comfort working with social analytics and performance metrics to organize and validate reporting, identify insights, and inform content and creative decisions.

  • Interest in fitness, health, technology, and the evolving social media landscape.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Corporate Strategy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Associate to help shape the company’s highest priority strategic decisions and long term direction. As a member of the Corporate Strategy team, you will work across Product, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and other functions to evaluate new opportunities, develop strategic recommendations, and help leadership make better decisions about where and how WHOOP invests.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong analytical foundation in investment banking, investing, consulting, or a similar environment who is looking to transition into a high growth technology company. You will combine rigorous analysis and financial modeling with clear, executive ready storytelling, while developing a deep understanding of WHOOP’s business, members, and market.

RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP believes in the power of humans to transform how they feel, perform and age; we serve the aspiring!

WHOOP is hiring an Electrical Engineer II to help accelerate the development of the next generation of WHOOP wearable technology and supporting hardware. As a member of the Hardware Engineering team, you will play a highly hands-on role in the design, test, characterization, and tuning of electrical circuitry, using rapid experimentation to build a deep understanding of system performance and drive better engineering decisions. You will work closely with Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Software teams to design and evaluate new hardware, investigate unexpected behavior, resolve complex technical challenges, and move products quickly from prototype to robust, production-ready solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, test, characterize, debug, and tune low-power, mixed-signal electronic circuits and systems throughout the product development lifecycle

  • Contribute to schematic design, component selection, PCB development, hardware prototyping, board bring-up, and design iteration

  • Develop and execute electrical experiments and characterization plans to understand system behavior, evaluate performance, identify root causes, and guide design improvements

  • Analyze test data and collaborate across Electrical, Firmware, Mechanical, and other engineering teams to optimize circuit performance, power consumption, signal integrity, reliability, and overall system performance

  • Support design verification, validation, and new product introduction (NPI), partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to resolve technical issues and enable successful high-volume production

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally to collaborate with partners, suppliers, and contract manufacturers

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years of relevant electrical engineering experience developing, testing, or debugging electronic hardware

  • Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals, including analog and digital circuit design, power management, signal integrity, and common communication interfaces

  • Hands-on experience designing, prototyping, testing, characterizing, and debugging electrical circuits and systems

  • Experience reading and developing schematics and working with ECAD tools such as Altium or equivalent

  • Strong laboratory skills using oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, soldering equipment, and other electronic test and measurement tools

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and experimentation to quickly develop an understanding of complex technical problems and drive them toward resolution

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

 

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

 

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $110,000 - $150,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

As we continue to grow globally, we are building the teams, systems, and capabilities needed to deliver exceptional member experiences and strengthen the WHOOP brand.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Manager, Creative Operations to lead complex, high-visibility creative initiatives and evolve the operational foundation that powers the Creative and Marketing organizations. Reporting to the Director of Brand Operations & Production, you will oversee strategic initiatives including product releases, cultural moments, and integrated brand campaigns while serving as a trusted operational partner to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

This role combines hands-on program leadership with broader operational ownership. You will ensure work is appropriately scoped, prioritized, resourced, and delivered while identifying opportunities to improve how teams collaborate and operate at scale. You will also manage and develop Creative Operations team members while maintaining direct ownership of critical programs.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead complex, high-visibility creative and marketing initiatives from planning through delivery, establishing clear scopes, timelines, owners, dependencies, budgets, and decision points.

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy across fast-moving initiatives, proactively identifying risks, resolving roadblocks, navigating tradeoffs, and escalating when appropriate to keep work moving forward.

  • Own resource, capacity, and budget planning across assigned projects and workstreams, identifying workload imbalances, financial risks, and opportunities to improve efficiency and prioritization.

  • Develop and implement scalable operational systems, processes, and ways of working in partnership with the Director of Brand Operations & Production, driving adoption and continuously improving how Creative and Marketing teams operate.

  • Build strong cross-functional accountability and handoffs throughout the creative development process, ensuring stakeholders understand requirements, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and decision points.

  • Manage and coach Creative Operations team members while supporting the evolution of the Creative organization’s operational infrastructure, including project management platforms, digital asset management systems, workflow automation, and AI-enabled tools.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative operations, marketing operations, project or program management, agency operations, or a related operational discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale, complex creative or marketing initiatives with significant budgets while balancing scope, resources, timelines, and financial considerations.

  • Strong understanding of creative development workflows, resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization within creative, brand, marketing, or integrated campaign organizations.

  • Experience designing and implementing operational processes, systems, and tools that improve collaboration, efficiency, and scalability across teams.

  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships with senior leaders, influence cross-functional stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and drive alignment across competing priorities.

WHOOP is seeking a Director of Global Trade Marketing to lead our global trade marketing organization and accelerate the growth and impact of WHOOP across our rapidly expanding retail footprint. This leader will oversee trade marketing teams across global markets, establishing the strategy, operating rhythms, and cross-functional alignment required to deliver exceptional retail experiences and drive consumer demand around the world.

At the center of this role is the ability to build strong relationships and drive alignment across the organization. You will serve as a critical connector between our Trade Marketing teams and the broader WHOOP organization, partnering closely with Sales, Brand, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Operations, Analytics, and regional leadership to ensure our teams are positioned for success in market. You will develop a high-performing global team, bring clarity to priorities in a fast-moving environment, and translate the broader WHOOP brand and commercial strategy into locally relevant retail experiences that drive awareness, conversion, and sell-through.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the global Trade Marketing organization, creating clear priorities, strong operating rhythms, and a culture of collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across WHOOP, aligning Brand, Creative, Media, Sales, Operations, Visual Merchandising, Product Marketing, Analytics, and regional stakeholders around retail priorities, launches, campaigns, and key commercial moments. Proactively identify dependencies, remove barriers, and ensure teams have the resources and organizational support needed to execute successfully.

  • Build scalable tools, processes, and ways of working that allow teams to move quickly while maintaining a consistent WHOOP experience globally, balancing global standards with the localization required to win with consumers and retail partners in individual markets.

  • 10+ years of experience in global trade marketing, shopper marketing, retail marketing, omnichannel marketing, or a related discipline, including meaningful experience leading teams in a global or multi-market environment.

  • Proven people leader with experience building, developing, and empowering high-performing teams across global markets.

  • Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills, with a demonstrated ability to bring together diverse cross-functional stakeholders, create alignment without relying solely on authority, and move complex initiatives forward.

  • Strong understanding of the global retail and omnichannel landscape, with experience developing marketing strategies that connect digital retail, physical retail, retail media, product launches, promotions, and brand activity.

  • Strategic and commercially minded, with the ability to translate company objectives into clear priorities for teams while remaining close enough to execution to identify barriers and unblock the organization.

  • Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

 - Build strong cross-functional partnerships across WHOOP, aligning Brand, Creative, Media, Sales, Operations, Visual Merchandising, Product Marketing, Analytics, and regional stakeholders around retail priorities, launches, campaigns, and key commercial moments. Proactively identify dependencies, remove barriers, and ensure teams have the resources and organizational support needed to execute successfully.

 - Develop and own the global trade marketing strategy, translating company and brand priorities into scalable plans across retail media, digital and physical retail experiences, product launches, promotions, training, and key commercial moments.

 - Partner with Trade Marketing and Sales leaders across global markets to build strategic plans for priority retailers, ensuring marketing investment, creative, inventory, training, fixtures, and operational readiness come together to drive measurable awareness, traffic, conversion, and sell-through.

 - Establish a consistent global approach to planning, budgeting, measurement, and performance optimization, using retailer and consumer insights to prioritize investments, identify incremental growth opportunities, and continuously improve return on trade marketing spend.

 - Build scalable tools, processes, and ways of working that allow teams to move quickly while maintaining a consistent WHOOP experience globally, balancing global standards with the localization required to win with consumers and retail partners in individual markets.

QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 10+ years of experience in global trade marketing, shopper marketing, retail marketing, omnichannel marketing, or a related discipline, including meaningful experience leading teams in a global or multi-market environment.

 - Proven people leader with experience building, developing, and empowering high-performing teams across global markets.

 - Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills, with a demonstrated ability to bring together diverse cross-functional stakeholders, create alignment without relying solely on authority, and move complex initiatives forward.

 - Strong understanding of the global retail and omnichannel landscape, with experience developing marketing strategies that connect digital retail, physical retail, retail media, product launches, promotions, and brand activity.

 - Strategic and commercially minded, with the ability to translate company objectives into clear priorities for teams while remaining close enough to execution to identify barriers and unblock the organization.

 - Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience managing significant marketing budgets, evaluating performance, and using consumer, retailer, and sales insights to make investment and prioritization decisions.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, highly cross-functional environment where priorities evolve quickly and success requires both building scalable processes and solving immediate business challenges.

 - Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.



This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.
